name: OER Deceleration -> Long TLT
rule: Use FRED CUSR0000SEHC (CPI shelter/OER proxy). When YoY decelerates by >2pp from 6mo peak: long TLT 126 days. Shelter disinflation = lower CPI = bond rally.

name: Bank Reserves Surge -> Long QQQ
rule: Long QQQ 126d when TOTRESNS 3-month rolling change > +15%

name: Mining IP Recovery -> Long XOP+PICK
rule: Long XOP+PICK 126d when IPN213111S YoY turns positive after 6+ months negative

name: Auto Loan DQ Trough → Long ALLY+COF
rule: Load FRED DRCARLACBS (quarterly auto loan delinquency rate). Find local minima below 2.5%. Long ALLY+COF equal-weight for 252 trading days from the quarter after the trough.

name: Personal Income YoY Reaccelerates > +5% → Long XLY
rule: Load FRED PI (monthly personal income). Compute YoY growth. When YoY crosses above +5% after 6+ months below +3%: long XLY for 126 trading days. Income acceleration leads consumer spending by 1-2 months.

backtest_result.verdict: WINNER — strong Sharpe (1.36), CAGR (25.6%), 6/7 wins, t=2.55

name: FRED Corporate Profits YoY Turns Positive After 2Q Negative → Long SPY 12mo
rule: Load FRED CP (quarterly corporate profits after tax with IVA and CCAdj). Compute YoY % change each quarter. Entry: when CP YoY turns positive after 2+ consecutive quarters of negative YoY growth. Long SPY for 252 trading days (12 months). Exit after 252 trading days or if CP YoY turns negative again (stop-loss). Benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold.
entry_conditions: FRED CP YoY growth turns positive (>0%) after 2+ consecutive quarters of negative YoY
Signal evaluated quarterly when BEA releases NIPA corporate profits data
exit_conditions: Early exit if CP YoY turns negative again within holding period

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED CP (quarterly corporate profits after tax)

backtest_approach: Load FRED CP quarterly back to 1947 (or whenever SPY data starts ~1993). Compute YoY. Identify all transition events from negative->positive YoY. On the first trading day after each event, go long SPY for 252 days. Compute per-trade returns and aggregate Sharpe/CAGR/max_dd vs buy-and-hold SPY. Known events: ~2002Q1 (post dot-com), ~2010Q1 (post GFC), ~2016Q2 (post energy recession), ~2020Q4 (post COVID).
implementation_notes: FRED CP is quarterly with ~2 month lag. BEA advance estimate comes ~1 month after quarter end (late Apr for Q1, late Jul for Q2, etc). Use release date, not quarter date. CP series has IVA+CCAdj adjustments — use the adjusted series for cleaner signal.

name: FRED Private Nonres Construction YoY > +10% for 3mo → Long PWR+PRIM+ACM
rule: Load FRED PNRESCONS (monthly private nonresidential construction spending). Compute YoY % change. Entry: when YoY exceeds +10% for 3 consecutive months. Long equal-weight basket of PWR, PRIM, ACM plus SPY benchmark for 126 trading days. Exit after 126 days.
entry_conditions: FRED PNRESCONS YoY growth > +10% for 3 consecutive months
Signal evaluated monthly on construction spending release (1st business day of month, 2-month lag)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PNRESCONS (monthly private nonresidential construction spending)

backtest_approach: Load FRED PNRESCONS monthly back to 2002. Compute YoY. Identify all 3-month streak entries where YoY > +10%. On the first trading day after the 3rd consecutive month confirmation, go long equal-weight PWR+PRIM+ACM for 126 days. Compute basket return vs SPY. Note: PRIM may have limited history (IPO ~2018); use available tickers only for their available period. PWR has data back to ~2003.
known_events: 2005-2006 (housing boom commercial)
2014-2015 (energy capex)
2022-2025 (reshoring/data center)
implementation_notes: PRIM IPO was 2018 — only use it from 2018 onward. ACM has data back to ~2014 (post-URS merger). PWR back to ~2002. For early period, basket may be PWR-only. Construction spending data has a 2-month lag (e.g., January data released in March).

name: FRED Real Disposable Income YoY Turns Negative → Long XLP 12mo
rule: Load FRED DSPIC96 (monthly real disposable personal income). Compute YoY % change. Entry: first month YoY turns negative (<0%) after 12+ months of positive YoY. Long XLP for 252 trading days. Measure XLP relative performance vs SPY over the holding period. Thesis: during real income squeezes, staples outperform discretionary/broad market.
entry_conditions: FRED DSPIC96 YoY turns negative (<0%) for the first time after 12+ months positive
Signal evaluated monthly on BEA personal income release (~last week of month, 1-month lag)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DSPIC96 (monthly real disposable personal income)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DSPIC96 monthly back to 1959. Compute YoY. Identify all transition events from positive->negative YoY after 12+ months positive. For each event, long XLP for 252 trading days and compute excess return vs SPY. XLP data starts ~1998; historical events before that can only test with sector proxies or be excluded. Key metric: XLP minus SPY total return over holding period.
known_events: 2001 (post dot-com)
2022 (inflation squeeze)
implementation_notes: Real disposable income can turn negative due to inflation surges (2022) OR income declines (2008). Both trigger trade-down behavior. COVID stimulus checks created a massive YoY distortion in 2020-2021 — may want to flag that event as anomalous. XLP inception ~1998.

name: FRED Advance Retail Sales 3 Consecutive Positive MoM → Long XRT 60d
rule: Load FRED RSAFS (monthly advance retail sales, seasonally adjusted). Compute MoM % change. Entry: when MoM is positive for 3 consecutive months. Long XRT (SPDR S&P Retail ETF) for 60 trading days. Exit after 60 days. Benchmark: SPY over same period.
entry_conditions: FRED RSAFS MoM change positive (>0%) for 3 consecutive months
Signal evaluated monthly on Census advance retail sales release (mid-month, ~2 week lag)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED RSAFS (monthly advance retail sales, seasonally adjusted)

backtest_approach: Load FRED RSAFS monthly back to 1992. Compute MoM pct change. Identify all 3-month positive streak completions. On the next trading day after the 3rd month's data release, long XRT for 60 trading days. Compute return vs SPY. XRT inception ~2006; use only events from 2006 onward. Count events, win rate, avg return, Sharpe.
known_events: Multiple per cycle — consumer momentum streaks happen regularly
implementation_notes: XRT inception June 2006. For pre-2006 events, could substitute XLY as proxy but XRT is better (broader retail coverage, equal-weighted). RSAFS is seasonally adjusted — no need for seasonal detrending. The 3-month streak filter avoids whipsaws from single-month noise.

name: FRED Mortgage Apps Surge >20% from 13-Week Low → Long LEN+DHI+NVR (1mo lag)
rule: Use a mortgage application proxy: FRED MORTGAGE30US (30yr mortgage rate) declining >50bps from 13-week high as a proxy for application surge (lower rates = more applications). If FRED has a direct MBA purchase index (MORTAPPW or similar), use that instead. Entry: 21 trading days (1 month) after the rate decline threshold is crossed. Long equal-weight LEN+DHI+NVR for 126 trading days. Exit after 126 days. Benchmark: SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED MORTGAGE30US declines >50bps from trailing 13-week high (proxy for mortgage application surge)
OR if FRED MORTAPPW available: purchase index rises >20% from trailing 13-week low
Entry delayed by 21 trading days (1-month lag for applications-to-closings pipeline)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED MORTGAGE30US (weekly 30yr mortgage rate) or FRED MORTAPPW (MBA purchase applications if available)

backtest_approach: Load FRED MORTGAGE30US weekly back to 1971. Compute 13-week trailing high. Entry signal when current rate is >50bps below that high, with 21 trading day delay. Long equal-weight LEN+DHI+NVR for 126 days. Compute basket return vs SPY. LEN/DHI have data back to ~2000; NVR to ~1993. If MORTAPPW not on FRED, the mortgage rate decline proxy captures the same dynamic (rate drops drive application surges with 0.85+ correlation).
known_events: 2003 (refi boom)
2012 (post-GFC recovery)
2019 (mid-cycle cut)
2020 (COVID rate cuts)
2024 (rate peak rollover)
implementation_notes: The 1-month entry delay is critical — it allows the applications-to-closings pipeline to build before entering. MORTAPPW may not be on FRED (MBA data is semi-proprietary). The mortgage rate proxy is a reasonable substitute with strong historical correlation to purchase applications. NVR has limited float and can be illiquid — consider substituting PHM or TOL if NVR data is spotty.

name: Tanker Stock 2-Week Momentum Spike >15% → Long FRO+STNG+INSW 20d
rule: Since BDTI is not directly available on FRED or yfinance, proxy tanker rate spikes via tanker equity momentum: when equal-weight FRO+STNG+INSW basket 10-day return exceeds +15%, the tanker rate spike is already visible in equity prices but continuation is likely. Long equal-weight FRO+STNG+INSW for 20 additional trading days from the signal. Benchmark vs SPY. Alternative: use crude oil futures curve backwardation as tanker demand proxy (FRED DCOILWTICO spot vs CL=F 6mo).
entry_conditions: Equal-weight FRO+STNG+INSW basket 10-day return exceeds +15%
Signals tanker rate spike underway with momentum continuation expected

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (BDTI not available on FRED; using equity momentum proxy)

backtest_approach: Load yfinance FRO, STNG, INSW daily back to max available. Compute equal-weight basket. Identify all 10-day windows where basket return > +15%. Long basket for next 20 trading days. Compute per-event returns and aggregate metrics vs SPY. FRO data from ~2001, STNG from ~2014, INSW from ~2014. Use FRO-only for earlier period.
known_events: 2008 (VLCC rate spike)
2020 (contango storage play)
2022 (Russia rerouting)
2024 (Red Sea disruption)
implementation_notes: BDTI is not on FRED or yfinance. Equity momentum proxy is imperfect but captures the same dynamic. STNG and INSW are product tankers (dirty = crude, clean = products); FRO is VLCC crude. Basket captures both segments. Could also test using DCOILWTICO 1-month return > 10% as entry proxy.

name: FRED DRTSCLCC Crosses Zero from Negative → Long XLY 63d
rule: Load FRED DRTSCLCC (net % of banks tightening standards for credit card loans, quarterly SLOOS). Entry: when DRTSCLCC crosses from negative (tightening) to zero or positive (easing). Long XLY for 63 trading days (1 quarter). Benchmark vs SPY. The zero-crossing signals credit availability inflection for consumers.
entry_conditions: FRED DRTSCLCC crosses from negative territory to zero or positive
Signal evaluated quarterly on SLOOS release (typically late Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DRTSCLCC (SLOOS consumer installment/credit card willingness, quarterly)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DRTSCLCC quarterly back to 1996 (series start). Identify all negative-to-zero/positive crossings. Long XLY for 63 trading days from the first trading day after SLOOS release. Compute XLY excess return vs SPY per event and aggregate. XLY inception 1998; use events from 1998 onward.
known_events: 2003 (post dot-com easing)
2010 (post GFC easing)
2014 (mid-cycle easing)
2021 (post COVID easing)
implementation_notes: DRTSCLCC is quarterly with limited observations. Verify FRED series name -- may also be SUBLPDRCSC or DRTSCLCC. Check for correct series ID. Small sample size is the main risk for this backtest.

name: Corn Futures Jul 15 Seasonal Entry When Crop Conditions Suggest Yield Risk
rule: Without direct access to USDA Crop Progress data in backtester, use a seasonal proxy: long ZC=F from Jul 15 to Aug 15 each year (peak pollination stress window). Compare returns in years where corn conditions were poor (known events) vs all years. If ZC=F not available or illiquid on yfinance, use CORN ETF as alternative. Benchmark vs SPY.
entry_conditions: July 15 each year (peak corn pollination risk window)
Ideally conditioned on USDA crop progress showing silking delay, but seasonal entry as fallback

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED PCORN (corn price proxy for validation) or none

backtest_approach: Load yfinance ZC=F daily. Compute Jul 15 to Aug 15 return each year. Compare all-year average vs known stressed years (2012 drought, 2019 delayed planting, 2021 drought). If ZC=F has gaps, use CORN ETF (inception 2010). Small sample for stressed years -- present as event study rather than systematic strategy.
known_events: 2012 (severe drought)
2019 (record delayed planting)
2021 (Western drought)
implementation_notes: ZC=F on yfinance may have liquidity gaps or contract roll issues. CORN ETF is a more reliable proxy (uses front-month futures). The unconditioned seasonal trade (always long Jul 15-Aug 15) captures the weather risk premium but has weaker Sharpe than conditioned version. USDA Crop Progress data is not on FRED.

name: FRED JTSJOL Declines >15% from Peak → Long RHI+MAN 126d
rule: Load FRED JTSJOL (job openings level, monthly JOLTS). Compute rolling 12-month peak. Entry: when JTSJOL declines >15% from its trailing 12-month peak. Long equal-weight RHI+MAN for 126 trading days. Thesis: labor market cooling drives companies back to temp staffing agencies. Benchmark vs SPY.
entry_conditions: FRED JTSJOL (job openings) declines >15% from trailing 12-month peak
Signal evaluated monthly on JOLTS release (first week of month, 2-month lag)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED JTSJOL (JOLTS job openings level, monthly)

backtest_approach: Load FRED JTSJOL monthly back to 2000 (series start). Compute trailing 12-month peak. Identify all months where level is >15% below peak. Long equal-weight RHI+MAN for 126 days from the first qualifying month. Avoid overlapping trades. RHI data from ~2000, MAN from ~1990. Compute basket vs SPY.
known_events: 2001 (dot-com bust)
2020 (COVID)
2023-24 (post-pandemic normalization)
implementation_notes: JOLTS data starts Dec 2000. RHI and MAN are the two largest publicly traded staffing firms. HAYS is London-listed and may not be on yfinance US. The thesis is counterintuitive -- openings decline = GOOD for staffing firms -- so careful framing needed. Distinct from PL081 (quits rate recovery) in that this uses openings decline as the trigger.

name: FRED DGORDER 3mo MoM Acceleration → Long AMAT+LRCX+KLAC 63d
rule: Load FRED DGORDER (monthly durable goods new orders). Compute MoM % change. Entry: when MoM is positive AND increasing for 3 consecutive months (accelerating). Long equal-weight AMAT+LRCX+KLAC for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and SOXX. The durable goods acceleration signals capex cycle turn that benefits semi equipment disproportionately.
entry_conditions: FRED DGORDER MoM positive and increasing for 3 consecutive months
Signal evaluated monthly on Census durable goods release (~26th of month)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, SOXX, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DGORDER (monthly durable goods new orders)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DGORDER monthly back to 1992. Compute MoM changes. Identify 3-month acceleration streaks (each MoM > prior MoM AND positive). Long equal-weight AMAT+LRCX+KLAC for 63 days. All three have data back to ~1995. Compute basket excess return vs SPY and vs SOXX (semi benchmark).
known_events: 2003 (post dot-com capex recovery)
2010 (post GFC)
2017 (memory capex boom)
2021 (post COVID)
implementation_notes: DGORDER includes volatile Boeing orders -- consider also testing with NEWORDER (ex-transport) for cleaner signal. The 3-month acceleration filter is strict and may fire infrequently. SOXX is the relevant sector benchmark, not SPY.

name: FRED NGTRSTUS Aug 1 Storage < 5yr Avg by >10% → Long NG=F Aug-Nov
rule: Load FRED NGTRSTUS (weekly natural gas storage). On August 1 each year, compute current storage level vs 5-year average for that week. If current storage is >10% below the 5-year average: long NG=F from Aug 1 through Nov 30. This targets the late-injection concern before winter. Benchmark vs SPY. Distinct from PL058 (Oct deficit, general winter) -- this is specifically summer injection shortfall, earlier entry.
entry_conditions: August 1 each year
FRED NGTRSTUS current level >10% below 5-year average for that calendar week
backtest_approach: Load FRED NGTRSTUS weekly. For each year, compute 5-year trailing average for the week containing Aug 1. If actual < 0.9 * avg: long NG=F Aug 1 to Nov 30. Compute annual trade P&L. NG=F may have contract roll issues on yfinance; UNG ETF (inception 2007) as backup. Test 2007-2025.
known_events: 2012 (hot summer, low storage)
2014 (polar vortex recovery)
2018 (production lag)
2022 (record exports to EU)
implementation_notes: NGTRSTUS on FRED may only have total, not the 5-year average. Compute the 5-year average manually from historical data. NG=F on yfinance rolls continuously which introduces roll return distortion. UNG ETF is a reasonable proxy but decays due to contango. For accuracy, note that storage levels are reported with a 1-week lag.

name: FRED PERMIT1 YoY Improving for 3 Consecutive Months → Long SHW+VMC+MLM+BLDR 63d
rule: Load FRED PERMIT1 (single-family building permits, monthly SAAR). Compute YoY % change. Entry: when the YoY rate improves (becomes less negative or more positive) for 3 consecutive months. Long equal-weight SHW+VMC+MLM+BLDR for 63 trading days. The YoY improvement signals the housing trough even if absolute YoY is still negative. Benchmark vs SPY and XHB.
entry_conditions: FRED PERMIT1 YoY rate of change improves (delta of YoY is positive) for 3 consecutive months
Signal evaluated monthly on Census permits release (mid-month, 1-month lag)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance SHW, VMC, MLM, BLDR, XHB, SPY

backtest_approach: Load FRED PERMIT1 monthly back to 1959. Compute YoY, then compute month-over-month change in YoY (second derivative). Entry when 3 consecutive months of positive second derivative. Long basket for 63 days. SHW from ~1980, VMC from ~1990, MLM from ~1994, BLDR from ~2016 (IPO). For early period use available tickers only. Compare basket vs XHB and SPY.
known_events: 2009 (post GFC trough)
2011 (housing recovery)
2019 (rate cut relief)
2023 (post-rate-shock recovery)
implementation_notes: BLDR IPO ~2016 -- use only from then onward. The second-derivative signal (rate of change of rate of change) is more sensitive than absolute levels and fires earlier in the cycle. SHW is a mega-cap paint company -- lower beta than VMC/MLM but more liquid. XHB is the sector benchmark for relative performance comparison.

name: FRED DTWEXBGS 6-Month Return < -5% → Long EEM 63d
rule: Load FRED DTWEXBGS (broad trade-weighted dollar index, daily). Compute rolling 6-month (126 trading day) return. Entry: when 6-month return crosses below -5%. Long EEM for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY. Distinct from PL046 (DXY spike → EM reversal) -- that was a mean-reversion trade after sharp dollar STRENGTH; this is momentum following dollar WEAKNESS.
entry_conditions: FRED DTWEXBGS 6-month rolling return crosses below -5% (dollar weakening >5% over 6mo)
Signal evaluated daily

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED DTWEXBGS (broad trade-weighted dollar index, daily)

backtest_approach: Load FRED DTWEXBGS daily back to 2006. Compute 126-day rolling return. Identify all dates where it crosses below -5%. Long EEM for 63 days from each signal (avoid overlapping trades -- skip signals within 63 days of prior entry). EEM data from 2003. Compute excess return vs SPY per trade and aggregate. Also test with VWO as alternative.
known_events: 2006-2007 (pre-GFC dollar weakness)
2017 (synchronized global growth)
2020 (post-COVID dollar decline)
2023 (dollar peak rollover)
implementation_notes: DTWEXBGS is daily but has some gaps (holidays/weekends). Use business day alignment with yfinance data. The signal may cluster (multiple daily crossings) -- use first crossing only and skip 63 days. Distinct from PL046 which was short-term DXY spike reversal; this is medium-term dollar weakness momentum.

name: FRED TLRESCONS 3 Consecutive Positive MoM → Long WSO+WMS 63d
rule: Load FRED TLRESCONS (total residential construction spending, monthly). Compute MoM % change. Entry: when MoM is positive for 3 consecutive months after a period of decline (at least 2 prior negative MoM months). Long equal-weight WSO+WMS for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and XHB. Plumbing/HVAC distributors benefit first from construction restart as they supply materials before framing/finishing trades.
entry_conditions: FRED TLRESCONS MoM positive for 3 consecutive months
Must follow at least 2 months of negative MoM (confirms inflection, not continuation)
Signal evaluated monthly on Census C30 release (1st business day, 2-month lag)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED TLRESCONS (total residential construction spending, monthly)

backtest_approach: Load FRED TLRESCONS monthly back to 2002. Compute MoM changes. Identify sequences of 2+ negative MoM followed by 3+ positive MoM (inflection). Long WSO+WMS for 63 days from the 3rd positive month. WSO (Watsco, HVAC distributor) data from ~1990. WMS (Advanced Drainage Systems) data from ~2014 (IPO). For pre-2014, WSO-only basket. Compute vs SPY.
known_events: 2009 (post GFC trough)
2012 (housing recovery)
2020 (post COVID)
2023 (post rate shock)
implementation_notes: WMS (Advanced Drainage Systems) IPO was 2014. SWK (Stanley Black & Decker) from original thesis could substitute for broader tool exposure but is less pure-play plumbing/HVAC. WSO is the purest HVAC distribution play in US equities. Construction spending data has a 2-month lag. Verify FRED series name is TLRESCONS (may also be filed under PRRESCONS for private only).

name: FRED WTREGEN Treasury General Account Rebuild → Long Short-Duration Bonds
rule: Load FRED WTREGEN (Treasury General Account, weekly). Compute 4-week change. Entry: when TGA increases by >$100B in 4 weeks (debt ceiling rebuild). Wait 4 weeks for funding stress to peak, then long SHV for 42 trading days. Benchmark vs BIL.
backtest_approach: Load FRED WTREGEN weekly. Identify all 4-week windows where TGA increases >$100B. After a 4-week wait, long SHV for 42 days. Compute excess return vs BIL. Known events: 2019 (post-ceiling), 2021 (post-ceiling), 2023 (post-ceiling). Small sample.

name: FRED TOTCI Total Commercial & Industrial Loans YoY Trough → Long Regional Banks
rule: Load FRED TOTCI or BUSLOANS (C&I loans, weekly). Compute YoY change. Entry: when YoY reaches trough and turns upward for 4 consecutive weeks. Long KRE for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY.
backtest_approach: Load FRED BUSLOANS weekly. Compute 52-week YoY. Identify troughs where YoY turns positive for 4 consecutive weeks after declining. Long KRE for 63 days. KRE inception 2006. Compute vs SPY.

name: FRED FRGSHPUSM649NCIS Real Government Spending Acceleration → Long Defense Prime
rule: Load FRED FGCE (federal government consumption expenditures, quarterly). Entry: when QoQ growth accelerates for 2 consecutive quarters. Long equal-weight LMT+RTX+NOC+GD for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and ITA.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance LMT, RTX, NOC, GD, ITA, SPY

backtest_approach: Load FRED FGCE quarterly. Compute QoQ growth. Entry when 2 consecutive quarters of accelerating growth. Long defense basket for 63 days. All tickers have long history (LMT from ~1995, NOC from ~1994). Compute basket vs SPY and ITA.

name: NOAA Palmer Drought Severity Index Extreme → Long Water Utilities
rule: Use FRED CUSR0000SEHG (water/sewer CPI) as drought-impact proxy since PDSI not on FRED. When water CPI YoY exceeds +5% for 3 months (utility surcharges kicking in), long AWK+WTR for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs XLU and SPY.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance AWK, WTR, SJW, XLU, SPY

backtest_approach: Load FRED CUSR0000SEHG01 monthly. Compute YoY. Entry when YoY > +5% for 3 months. Long AWK+WTR for 63 days. AWK from ~2008 IPO. Alternative: known drought years (2012, 2015, 2021, 2022) as event study.

name: USDA World Ag Supply & Demand (WASDE) Soybean Ending Stocks Surprise → Long Soyb
rule: Without WASDE consensus estimates in backtester, use seasonal WASDE release dates. Long ZS=F for 5 trading days around each WASDE release (published ~10th of each month). Test whether WASDE months show systematically different soybean returns. Benchmark vs SPY.
backtest_approach: Load yfinance ZS=F daily. Identify WASDE release dates (typically 10th-12th of each month). Compute 5-day return starting WASDE release date. Compare to non-WASDE-week 5-day returns. If ZS=F unavailable, use SOYB ETF (inception 2011).

name: FRED PCEPILFE Core PCE 3mo Annualized Below 2% → Long Growth/Tech (QQQ)
rule: Load FRED PCEPILFE (core PCE, monthly). Compute 3-month annualized rate. Entry: first time 3mo annualized drops below 2.0% after being above 3.0% for 6+ months. Long QQQ for 42 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and VTV.
backtest_approach: Load FRED PCEPILFE monthly. Compute 3-month annualized change. Identify events where it crosses below 2.0% after 6+ months above 3.0%. Long QQQ for 42 days. QQQ inception 1999. Historical events rare -- 2003, 2012, 2023 possible. Small sample event study.

name: FRED RAILFRGCARLOADSD11 Railroad Carloads Chemical Group Surge → Long Specialty
rule: Load FRED RAILFRTCARLOADSD11 (railroad carloads total, monthly). Compute YoY. Entry: when YoY crosses above +5% after 3+ months negative. Long equal-weight DD+LYB+EMN for 63 trading days as chemical demand proxy. Benchmark vs SPY and XLB.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance DD, LYB, EMN, XLB, SPY

backtest_approach: Load FRED RAILFRGCARLOADSD11 monthly. Compute YoY. Entry on positive crossing above +5% after negative period. Long DD+LYB+EMN for 63 days. DD data from ~2019 (DowDuPont split), LYB from ~2010 (IPO), EMN from ~1994. Use available tickers per period.

name: FRED ISRATIO Total Business Inventory/Sales Ratio Decline → Long Small Cap Value
rule: Load FRED ISRATIO (total business inventory/sales ratio, monthly). Entry: when ISRATIO declines for 3 consecutive months from a level above 1.40. Long IWN for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs IWF and SPY.
backtest_approach: Load FRED ISRATIO monthly. Identify all 3-month declining streaks starting from >1.40. Long IWN for 63 days. IWN inception 2000. Compute excess return vs IWF (growth) and SPY.

name: FRED CPIAUCSL CPI Monthly Print Below Consensus → Long TLT Same-Day
rule: Load FRED CPIAUCSL (CPI, monthly). Compute MoM % change. Since we cannot access consensus estimates in backtester, proxy the surprise as: MoM < prior month MoM by >0.1pp (decelerating inflation). Long TLT for 5 trading days on CPI release date when MoM decelerates. Benchmark vs SPY.
backtest_approach: Load FRED CPIAUCSL monthly. Compute MoM. For each month where MoM decelerates by >0.1pp vs prior month, long TLT for 5 trading days starting CPI release date (typically ~13th of month). Compute per-event and aggregate returns.

name: FRED BOGZ1FL073164003Q Household Net Worth to GDP Trough → Long SPY Multi-Month
rule: Load FRED TNWBSHNO (household net worth, quarterly) and FRED GDP (quarterly). Compute ratio. Entry: when ratio shows 2 consecutive quarterly increases after a decline. Long SPY for 126 trading days. Benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold.

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED TNWBSHNO (household net worth quarterly), FRED GDP

backtest_approach: Load FRED TNWBSHNO and GDP quarterly. Compute ratio. Identify 2-quarter recovery signals after decline. Long SPY for 126 days. Z.1 data has long history but is quarterly with ~3 month lag. Known events: 2003, 2009, 2020.

name: FRED REVOLSL Revolving Consumer Credit Deceleration → Long XLP Defensive Rotatio
rule: Load FRED REVOLSL (revolving consumer credit, monthly). Compute YoY. Entry: when YoY decelerates by >3pp in 2 months (e.g., from +8% to +5% in 2 months). Long XLP for 42 trading days. Benchmark vs XLY and SPY.
backtest_approach: Load FRED REVOLSL monthly. Compute YoY. Compute 2-month change in YoY rate. Entry when 2-month change < -3pp. Long XLP for 42 days. Compute XLP excess return vs XLY (rotation signal) and vs SPY.

name: FRED PPIACO Producer Price Index Crude Materials Surge → Long Commodity Miners (
rule: Load FRED PPICRM or PPIACO (PPI crude materials/all commodities, monthly). Compute MoM. Entry: when MoM exceeds +5%. Long XME for 42 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY.
backtest_approach: Load FRED PPICRM monthly back to 1926 (limited use pre-2006 for XME). Identify all months with MoM > +5%. Long XME for 42 days. XME inception 2006. Compute vs SPY.

name: FRED IPMAN Manufacturing IP 3mo Rate of Change Inflection → Long Factory Automat
rule: Load FRED IPMAN (manufacturing IP, monthly). Compute 3-month rate of change (3mo annualized). Entry: when 3mo RoC crosses above 0 after 3+ months below 0. Long equal-weight ROK+AME+EMR for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and XLI.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance ROK, AME, EMR, XLI, SPY

backtest_approach: Load FRED IPMAN monthly. Compute 3-month annualized rate of change. Identify zero-crossings from below after 3+ months negative. Long ROK+AME+EMR for 63 days. All have data back to ~1995+. Compute basket vs XLI and SPY.

name: FRED DSPIC96 Real Disposable Personal Income 3mo Acceleration → Long Luxury/Prem
rule: Load FRED DSPIC96 (real DPI, monthly). Compute MoM. Entry: when 2nd derivative (change in MoM) is positive for 3 consecutive months. Long equal-weight RL+TPR+RH for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs XRT and SPY.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance RL, TPR, RH, XRT, SPY

backtest_approach: Load FRED DSPIC96 monthly. Compute MoM changes, then compute month-over-month acceleration (2nd derivative). Entry when 3 consecutive months of positive acceleration. Long RL+TPR+RH for 63 days. RL from ~1997, TPR from ~2017 (Tapestry rebrand), RH from ~2012. Use available tickers.

name: FRED AWHMAN Average Weekly Hours Manufacturing Inflection → Long Temp Staffing A
rule: Load FRED AWHMAN (avg weekly hours mfg, monthly). Entry: when AWHMAN rises for 3 consecutive months after a period of decline (at least 2 prior declining months). Long equal-weight RHI+ASGN for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY.

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED AWHMAN (monthly avg weekly hours mfg)

backtest_approach: Load FRED AWHMAN monthly. Identify 3-month rising streaks following 2+ month declines. Long RHI+ASGN for 63 days. RHI from ~2000, ASGN from ~2012 (formerly On Assignment). Compute vs SPY.

name: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Gasoline Days of Supply <22 → Long Refiner Margins (
rule: Load FRED GASDESW (gasoline days of supply estimate, weekly) if available. When days of supply drops below 22 between May-September: long equal-weight VLO+MPC+PSX for 21 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and XLE.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance VLO, MPC, PSX, XLE, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED GASDESW (gasoline days of supply) or EIA weekly data

backtest_approach: Load FRED GASDESW weekly if available (may need to verify series ID). Identify weeks May-Sep where days of supply < 22. Long VLO+MPC+PSX for 21 days. All refiners have data from ~2000+. MPC from ~2011 (Marathon spinoff), PSX from ~2012 (Phillips 66 spinoff). Compute vs XLE and SPY.

name: FRED DCOILWTICO WTI Crude Below $50 for 3 Months → Long E&P Recovery (XOP) Contr
rule: Load FRED DCOILWTICO (WTI crude spot, daily). Compute monthly average. Entry: when monthly avg stays below $50 for 3 consecutive months AND then bounces >15% from 3-month low. Long XOP for 126 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and XLE.
backtest_approach: Load FRED DCOILWTICO daily. Compute monthly averages. Identify 3-month sub-$50 periods followed by >15% bounce from trough. Long XOP for 126 days. XOP inception 2006. Known events: 2015-16, 2020. Small sample.

name: FRED MSPUS Median Home Sale Price YoY Deceleration → Long Mortgage REITs (NLY, A
rule: Load FRED MSPUS (median existing home sale price, quarterly). Compute YoY. Entry: when YoY decelerates from >10% to below 3% over 2 quarters. Long equal-weight NLY+AGNC for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and REM.
backtest_approach: Load FRED MSPUS quarterly. Compute YoY. Identify deceleration events from >10% to <3% in 2Q. Long NLY+AGNC for 63 days. NLY from ~1997, AGNC from ~2008. Compute vs SPY and REM.

name: FRED EXPGS Real Exports of Goods & Services Recovery → Long Industrial Exporters
rule: Load FRED EXPGS (real exports, quarterly). Compute QoQ growth. Entry: when QoQ growth accelerates for 2 consecutive quarters after deceleration. Long equal-weight CAT+DE+CMI for 63 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY and XLI.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance CAT, DE, CMI, XLI, SPY

implementation_notes: CALM is the only major pure-play publicly traded US shell egg producer. Their flock has historically been less affected (geographic diversification, biosecurity). name: NOAA Strong El Nino Signal -> Long Cocoa Futures via NIB
rule: Using yfinance and NOAA data: When NOAA CPC Oceanic Nino Index (ONI) crosses +1.5 (strong El Nino threshold), go long NIB (iPath Bloomberg Cocoa ETN) or CC=F (cocoa futures) on the first trading day of the following month. Hold for 126 trading days (approximately 6 months). Benchmark vs SPY. LONG-SIDE ONLY -- original idea included a short equity leg (HSY/MDLZ) which is excluded. The thesis is that strong El Nino events reduce rainfall in West Africa cocoa belt, cutting global supply 10-25% and driving cocoa prices up 30-80%.

Enter on first trading day of the month following the ONI crossing
Only trigger once per El Nino episode

backtest_approach: Event study: Identify months where ONI crossed +1.5 (strong El Nino onset): (1) 1997-05 (ONI +1.5, super El Nino), (2) 2009-07 (ONI +1.5), (3) 2015-04 (ONI +1.5, strong El Nino), (4) 2023-06 (ONI +1.5, strong El Nino). For each event, long CC=F for 126 trading days. NIB ETN launched 2008; use CC=F for full history. Cocoa data on yfinance (CC=F) back to 2000+. Compute per-event return and aggregate metrics. The El Nino/West Africa rainfall correlation is well-established in climate science (Ropelewski & Halpert 1987). The 2023-2024 El Nino drove cocoa to all-time highs above $10,000/ton.

2009-2010: Moderate El Nino; cocoa rallied ~30% as West Africa crop fell short

implementation_notes: ONI data is the standard ENSO classification used by NOAA. The +1.5 threshold corresponds to 'strong' El Nino, which occurs roughly every 10-15 years. With only 4 events since 1997, statistical power is limited, but the effect size is large and the climate mechanism is well-established in peer-reviewed literature. NIB ETN has tracking error and liquidity issues; CC=F is preferable for backtest. The 2023-2024 event is exceptional because it combined El Nino with structural underinvestment in West African cocoa farming. bt_feasibility is 4 because ONI data is clean and CC=F is liquid on yfinance.

Wages component (ECIWAG) remains positive YoY (no wage deflation -- consumer spending intact)
Enter on first trading day after BLS ECI quarterly release (last business day of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct)
Minimum 90 calendar days between signals

backtest_approach: Event study: Load FRED ECI benefits (ECIBEN) and wages (ECIWAG) quarterly data (2001-2025). Compute YoY growth each quarter. Identify quarters where benefits YoY decelerates >100bps from prior quarter while wages remain positive YoY. For each signal (90-day min gap), long SPY for 42 trading days. Compare per-signal returns vs unconditional SPY 42-day returns. Key expected signal quarters: 2003 Q4 (post-recession benefits cost moderation), 2010-2011 (ACA implementation changed benefits cost structure), 2017 (low health insurance inflation), 2024 Q2-Q3 (healthcare cost deceleration after COVID surge).
known_events: 2003 Q4-2004: Post-recession benefits cost moderation enabled corporate margin expansion
2010-2011: ACA implementation and recession aftermath lowered benefits cost growth temporarily
2017: Health insurance premium growth slowed after ACA marketplace stabilization
2020 Q2-Q3: COVID reduced healthcare utilization, temporarily lowering benefits costs

implementation_notes: BLS ECI is considered the gold standard for labor cost measurement because it controls for compositional shifts (unlike average hourly earnings). The benefits component is ~30% of total compensation and is dominated by healthcare insurance costs. Benefits cost deceleration is a cleaner margin expansion signal than wage deceleration because it does not impair consumer spending. FRED ECIBEN quarterly data starts 2001 Q2. bt_feasibility is 4 because FRED data is clean and quarterly. The main risk is that benefits cost deceleration may coincide with economic weakness, so the wages filter (must remain positive) guards against recession signals.

Identify spike-and-decline episodes: (1) 2008 Q4: GFC discount window peaked ~$110B, declined through Q1 2009; (2) 2020 Q1-Q2: COVID-era precautionary borrowing spiked then resolved; (3) 2023 Mar: SVB/Signature crisis spiked discount window to $153B, declined over 8 weeks. For each event, long KRE from signal date for 42 trading days vs SPY. The 2023 SVB episode is the cleanest modern test.
known_events: 2008 Q3-Q4: GFC discount window borrowing peaked at ~$110B; bank stocks bottomed Mar 2009

implementation_notes: Fed H.4.1 is published every Thursday at 4:30pm ET. Discount window borrowing above $10B is unusual and signals genuine stress (normal is near-zero due to stigma). The 50% decline threshold confirms the crisis is resolving rather than deepening. KRE launched June 2006, providing data for the GFC, COVID, and SVB episodes. bt_feasibility is 5 because FRED data is weekly, clean, and the crisis episodes are well-documented.

name: NOAA Hurricane Season Upgrade to Above-Normal -> Gulf Shut-In Risk -> E&P/Crude Long

Hold for 40 trading days. Benchmark vs SPY. NOAA issues the initial outlook in late May and an updated outlook in early August. Above-normal seasons increase the probability of Gulf of Mexico production shut-ins, supporting crude oil prices.

Predicted named storms > 20 (vs 30-year average of ~14)
Enter on first trading day after NOAA outlook publication (late May or early August update)
At most 2 signals per year (initial + mid-season update)

backtest_approach: Event study: For each year (2007-2025, XOP inception June 2006) where NOAA issued 'Above Normal' hurricane outlook, compute XOP return over 40 trading days post-outlook vs SPY. Above-normal years: 2010, 2011, 2012, 2017, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025. The signal fires frequently in recent years due to warmer SSTs. The NOAA outlook is a well-publicized event so some pricing may already occur, but the 'risk premium' tends to persist through peak hurricane season (August-October). bt_feasibility is 4 because NOAA outlooks are precisely dated, free, and the above-normal classification is binary/clear.

name: FDIC Call Report Fixed-Rate Loan Repricing Wall -> Community Bank NII Acceleration -> KRE Long

Current interest rate environment has rates higher than when original loans were originated
Enter on first trading day after FDIC quarterly aggregate publication

Enter on first trading day after monthly TIC data release (~15th of month, 2-month lag)

EIA Electric Power Monthly published monthly (free).

Prior 6 months showed flat or declining (<1%) industrial sales growth
Enter on first trading day after EIA monthly publication
Minimum 90 calendar days between signals

The curve must have been in backwardation (forward < spot) in the prior month
Enter on next trading day after contango flip confirmed
Minimum 90 calendar days between signals

The BDI is notoriously volatile so contango/backwardation flips occur multiple times per year. With 90-day gap, expect 2-4 events per year. Key recovery signals: 2009 Q1 (post-GFC rebound), 2012 Q4 (China stimulus), 2016 Q1 (BDI bottom), 2020 Q2 (post-COVID), 2023 Q1 (post-China-reopening). bt_feasibility is 3 because: (a) detailed FFA data is not freely available, (b) BDI is available but constructing the forward curve from public data is difficult.

2016 Q1: BDI hit all-time low of 290, contango flip preceded recovery
2020 Q2: COVID recovery drove dry bulk recovery
2023 Q1: China reopening expectations drove FFA contango
implementation_notes: The main bt_feasibility challenge is FFA data access. The BDI is published daily by the Baltic Exchange but the forward curve (FFA prices) requires subscription data from the Baltic Exchange or brokers like Clarksons. BDRY ETF (Breakwave) tracks near-term dry bulk futures and could serve as a proxy for the FFA curve shape, but its liquidity is limited. SBLK, GNK, GOGL are all profitable dry bulk operators with good yfinance data. bt_feasibility is 3.

implementation_notes: BLDP and FCEL are small-caps with high volatility; use auto_adjust=True to handle splits. PLUG had a 1-for-X reverse-split-prone history; ensure adjusted prices. Start data 2014-01-01 (FCEL and BLDP have history back further but liquidity thinner). Use auto_adjust=True. Composite crossing rule: previous-day composite <= 0.15 AND today composite > 0.15. Slippage assumption: enter and exit at next-day open. If basket symbol has missing data on entry day, skip that name and rebalance to remaining names equally.

name: EIA Form 860M Fossil Generator Retirement Cluster in PJM/MISO/ERCOT Drives Merchant IPP Re-Rating
rule: On each monthly EIA Form 860M release (mid-month), aggregate all confirmed (status='RE') and planned (status='P') fossil-fueled generator retirements (coal, oil, natural gas steam, petroleum coke) with planned retirement date within next 12 months, grouped by NERC region/balancing authority. SIGNAL fires when any of the three regions crosses 5.0% retirement share in the rolling 12-month forward window (rising-edge trigger only — fire once when crossing up). On signal trigger date (release date) at next NYSE close, enter LONG basket {VST, NRG, CEG} equal-weight 2.0% gross per name and SHORT XLU at 3.0% gross as utility-sector hedge. Hold for 252 trading days (~12 months) and exit.

Compute retiring fossil nameplate MW / installed fossil nameplate MW in PJM, MISO, ERCOT
Rising-edge trigger: prior month's share < 5.0% AND current month's share >= 5.0% in any of the three regions
On trigger date, enter LONG {VST, NRG, CEG} equal-weight 2.0% gross per name at next NYSE close
Simultaneously SHORT XLU at 3.0% gross at same close

backtest_approach: Monthly event-driven backtest: (1) Download EIA Form 860M historical archives 2015-01 to present (each monthly CSV preserved by EIA). (2) For each monthly release date, recompute installed nameplate MW per NERC region by aggregating operating units; recompute retiring MW (status RE or P within next 365 days) per region. (3) Compute monthly time-series of retire_share per region; detect rising-edge crossings of 5%. (4) For each crossing date, find next NYSE close t0. (5) Long-basket PnL: equal-weight cumulative log-return on {VST, NRG, CEG} from t0 to t+252, weighted 2% gross per name. (6) Short XLU PnL = -cumret(XLU) * 3% gross over same window. (8) Allow overlapping trades but cap concurrent exposure at one open position per region. (9) Equity curve: sum PnL paths; compute CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown. (10) Benchmark vs equal-weight long {VST, NRG, CEG} held continuously over same dates (buy-and-hold) to isolate alpha from timing signal.

name: BTC-USD Stagnation Regime -> Short Public Miner Basket vs Long BTC (IBIT)
rule: Daily proxy for hashprice collapse using BTC-USD price stagnation (since network hashrate trends monotonically upward and block subsidy is fixed at 3.125 BTC post-Apr-2024 halving). Compute three conditions: (a) BTC-USD 30-day trailing average close < BTC-USD 180-day trailing average close * 0.95 (BTC in a -5%+ medium-term drawdown), (b) BTC-USD close has not made a new 60-day high for at least 30 consecutive trading days (range-bound regime), (c) BTC-USD 30-day realized volatility (annualized, log returns) < 60% (non-panic stagnation, not capitulation). On the first day all three conditions are simultaneously true AND no position is open, signal fires. At the next regular session open, short an equal-weight basket of {MARA, RIOT, CLSK, CIFR} sized to 50% gross short, and go long IBIT sized to 50% gross long (dollar-neutral pair: isolates miner-specific margin compression from BTC beta). Daily PnL = 0.5*IBIT_ret - 0.5*0.25*(MARA_ret + RIOT_ret + CLSK_ret + CIFR_ret). Exit at (a) 30 trading days after entry close, OR (b) BTC-USD makes a new 60-day high (regime break), OR (c) cumulative PnL <= -8% (stop loss), whichever first.

No open position currently held
Trade is restricted to post-2024-04-19 dates (post-halving regime only)
IBIT trading-history start date >= entry date (IBIT inception 2024-01-11)
Enter at next session open after signal fire
exit_conditions: 30 trading days after entry (close of bar 30)
OR BTC-USD makes a new 60-day high (regime break, exit at close)
OR cumulative PnL <= -8% (stop loss at close)

name: FHWA National VMT YoY Decline Below -2% Predicts Toll-Concession Equity Underperformance and Muni-Bond Spread Widening
rule: Monthly: pull FRED TRFVOLUSM227NFWA (FHWA national moving 12-month VMT, seasonally adjusted). Compute YoY % change of the raw monthly value. SIGNAL FIRES on the first trading day of month M when the FRED prints for months M-2 and M-3 (most recent two FHWA prints available given ~45-day lag) both show VMT YoY < -2%. On signal: SHORT equal-weight basket of listed toll-concession equities {ALX.AX, DG.PA, FER.MC} at 3% gross short, and LONG equal-weight ETF basket {MUB, VTEB} at 3% gross long (hedge proxy for AAA muni-bond outperformance vs widening sub-AAA transportation revenue spreads — captured as relative ETF behavior through stress periods). HOLD for 90 calendar days (approximate quarter for next FHWA prints to confirm or reverse). EXIT EARLY if the latest available FHWA VMT YoY > 0% in any subsequent monthly print. Re-evaluate at month-end; if signal still active reopen position.
entry_conditions: FRED series TRFVOLUSM227NFWA monthly value YoY pct change < -2% for two most recent prints available (use FRED publication lag — typically months M-3 and M-2 of current month M).
Signal evaluated on first US trading day of each calendar month; position opened at that day's close.
Equal-weight short on toll-concession equity basket {ALX.AX 1%, DG.PA 1%, FER.MC 1%} (3% gross short).
Equal-weight long on muni-bond ETF basket {MUB 1.5%, VTEB 1.5%} (3% gross long).
exit_conditions: Most recent FHWA VMT YoY print > 0% — exit immediately at next month-end re-evaluation.
Re-entry permitted at the next month-end if signal still active.

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: TRFVOLUSM227NFWA (FHWA Moving 12-Month Total Vehicle Miles Traveled, monthly, seasonally adjusted)

backtest_approach: Monthly rebalancing daily PnL: at each calendar month-end, evaluate FRED VMT signal using the value FRED would have known at that point (account for ~45-day publication lag: at month-end of M use prints through M-2). When signal active, hold 3% gross short basket {ALX.AX, DG.PA, FER.MC} and 3% gross long basket {MUB, VTEB}; when inactive, flat. Compute daily PnL from log-returns of each leg, sum to portfolio daily return. Currency normalize: convert AUD (ALX.AX) and EUR (DG.PA, FER.MC) returns to USD using fxData; or use unhedged-local approximation (acceptable: ETFs MUB/VTEB are USD). Compare cumulative returns vs SPY buy-and-hold. Sample 2010-2026 to include 2020 COVID VMT crash, 2022-23 normalization, and 2026 EV-driven structural decline. Report CAGR, Sharpe (vs 0%), max drawdown, hit rate of signal episodes.

2022-06 inflation/gasoline-price VMT dip
2024 EV-share inflection
implementation_notes: (1) FHWA publication lag: when backtesting at month-end M, only use FRED VMT prints with FRED release date <= month-end M; the FRED ALFRED vintages capture this if needed, otherwise approximate by lagging 45 days. (2) ATL.MI removed from original idea — Mundys went private in 2022 buyout. (3) FX: convert ALX.AX (AUD) and DG.PA/FER.MC (EUR) to USD using yfinance 'AUDUSD=X' and 'EURUSD=X'. (4) If FX data fails, fall back to local-currency returns — toll-concession price action dominates FX noise on quarterly horizon. (5) No counter-signal flag on the idea, so this strategy is one-sided (short concessions + long munis on negative VMT signal).

name: NOAA SWPC G3+ Geomagnetic Storm Cluster Triggers Long Launch-Services + SAR/EO Operators vs Short Pure-Play LEO Operators and Space-Insurance Reinsurers
rule: Daily: pull NOAA GFZ Potsdam historical planetary Kp index (Kp value 0-9, free TXT). A G3+ storm corresponds to Kp >= 7 for at least one 3-hour interval in a UTC day. Compute rolling 21-day count of days containing any Kp >= 7 ('G3+ days'). SIGNAL FIRES at NYSE close on day T when trailing 21 calendar-day G3+ day count >= 2, OR any single Kp >= 8 (G4+) event occurred within trailing 21 days. On signal: LONG basket {RKLB 1.5%, PL 1%, BKSY 0.75%, ASTS 0.5%} = 3.75% gross long; SHORT basket {IRDM 1%, GSAT 0.75%, HNR1.DE 1%, MUV2.DE 1%} = 3.75% gross short. HOLD until earliest of: (a) 60 calendar days after entry, (b) trailing 30-day G3+ day count returns to 0. New signals override prior position (re-enter at fresh weights).
entry_conditions: GFZ Potsdam Kp daily index: any 3-hourly Kp >= 7 in trailing 21 calendar days, with at least 2 such days OR at least one Kp >= 8 event.
Position opened at next NYSE close after the qualifying Kp print is published (GFZ publishes near real-time, so same-day close acceptable).
Long basket: RKLB 1.5%, PL 1%, BKSY 0.75%, ASTS 0.5% (3.75% gross long).
Short basket: IRDM 1%, GSAT 0.75%, HNR1.DE 1%, MUV2.DE 1% (3.75% gross short).
exit_conditions: Trailing 30-day count of Kp >= 7 days returns to 0 — exit at next close.

(5) For cluster condition, recompute trailing-60d cluster count daily; bump macro spread pair weights when threshold crosses. (6) Sample window 2010-2026 includes 2015-16 energy-credit cluster, 2020 COVID covenant-breach wave, 2023 regional-bank stress, 2024 CRE cluster — high event density. (7) Report cumulative return, Sharpe, max drawdown, vs SPY benchmark; separately report issuer-short leg alpha and HYG-LQD spread-pair alpha.
known_events: 2015-Q4 to 2016-Q2 E&P covenant-breach cluster (Chesapeake, Halcon, etc.)
2020-Q2 COVID broad covenant relief wave (movie theaters, cruise lines, retail)
2023-Q1 SVB/regional-bank stress contagion
2024-Q3 commercial-real-estate office covenant breaches
implementation_notes: (1) EDGAR full-text search URL: https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22Item+2.04%22&forms=8-K&dateRange=custom&startdt=2010-01-01&enddt=YYYY-MM-DD. (2) Many 2.04 filings are technical amendments — backtester should filter for filings with material-default keywords ('default', 'breach', 'acceleration', 'covenant', 'cross-default') in the filing body to reduce noise; this is documented as a pre-processing step. (3) Sub-industry mapping via yfinance .info; tolerate missing values by using sector-level cluster. (4) HYG inception is 2007-04, LQD is 2002-07 — both cover the sample window. (5) Delisted-issuer handling: if yfinance returns no data for a ticker post a certain date, assume position closed at last available price * 0.5 (representing OTC mark) — this is conservative for a short. (6) No counter_signal flag — strategy is one-sided short bias. (7) Macro spread pair leverages the HYG-LQD pair (rather than HYG-only) so as to be carry-neutral.

name: 3x Leveraged ETF Rebalance Day Overnight Reversal -> Short QQQ on Large Up-Days (Daily Approx)
rule: Daily approximation of the leveraged-ETF MOC rebalance fade. On any trading day t where QQQ close-to-close return >= +2.0%, take a short position in QQQ at close of day t and cover at close of day t+1. Symmetric long: on any day where QQQ close-to-close return <= -2.0%, take a long QQQ position at close of day t and exit at close of day t+1. Captures the next-day fade of mechanical 3x-ETF MOC rebalance flow.
entry_conditions: QQQ close-to-close return on day t >= +2.0% OR <= -2.0%
Position: -1 (short) on +2% days, +1 (long) on -2% days, 0 otherwise
Enter at close of day t
exit_conditions: Exit at close of day t+1 (1 trading day hold)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: QQQ, TQQQ (for regime audit only), SPY

backtest_approach: Daily close-to-close approximation of an intraday-rebalance fade thesis. Compute QQQ daily returns. Build positions Series: -1 when prev-day QQQ return >= +0.02, +1 when prev-day QQQ return <= -0.02, else 0. Daily PnL = position[t] * QQQ_return[t+1]. Lag positions forward by 1 day to avoid look-ahead (the +2% reading is known at close of day t, position held overnight, PnL realized day t+1). Use harness.compute_metrics with SPY benchmark.
implementation_notes: The original idea is intraday (detect >+1.5% by 3pm, short MOC, cover next open). Pipeline harness load_prices returns adjusted-close only — Open/High/Low not available without a custom yfinance fetch. We approximate using daily close-to-close with a stricter +/-2.0% threshold (vs 1.5% intraday). This loses the intraday-overshoot edge but still captures the next-day mean-reversion component of forced rebalance flow. Hold 1 day (close-to-close). Sample size: high — ~50-100 trigger days per decade. TQQQ included only for context/audit (not traded).

name: S&P 500 Inclusion Announce-to-Effective Drift (Residual)
rule: Event study over historical S&P 500 inclusion additions. For each addition: t_ann = announcement date (close), t_eff = effective rebalance date (close). At t_ann+1 OPEN, go LONG the addition ticker; hold to t_eff CLOSE; exit. Equal-weight position size across overlapping events. PnL = avg daily return of currently-held addition basket. Capture residual t+1-to-effective drift after the announcement-day pop has happened.
entry_conditions: S&P DJI press release announces S&P 500 addition (publicly known with date stamp)
Open LONG the addition ticker at t_ann+1 (next trading day) open
exit_conditions: Close LONG at effective date close (typically Friday close, 5-7 trading days after announcement)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance for added tickers (resolved per event) + SPY benchmark
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: S&P DJI index announcement press releases (free, spglobal.com/spdji/en/index-announcements). Backtest event list: curated CSV of S&P 500 additions 2018-2025 (announce_date, effective_date, added_ticker). ~5-10 additions per year.

backtest_approach: Event study with curated historical addition event list (50+ events 2018-2025). For each event compute daily return path from t_ann+1 open to t_eff close for the added ticker. Aggregate to a daily PnL series by equal-weighting overlapping active legs. Report avg event return, hit rate, t-stat. Benchmark vs same-window SPY return.

The strategy isolates the t+1-to-effective residual (NOT the announcement-day pop), per Greenwood-Sammon 2022. Position is LONG only of the addition (deletion-leg often missing or low-liquidity post-deletion). Equal weight cap notional 100% of capital across simultaneously-active legs.

name: State DOI Insurance Withdrawal Cluster -> Long AIZ, Short Coastal Homebuilders
rule: Event study on known historical state DOI insurance withdrawal/non-renewal announcements from top-5 admitted insurers in concentrated coastal/wildfire states (FL, CA, LA). On trading day after each public announcement date, open: LONG AIZ (Assurant force-placed) 50% + SHORT equal-weight basket PHM, LEN (coastal homebuilders) 50%. Hold 90 trading days. Stack overlapping events equal-weight. PnL = AIZ daily return - average(PHM,LEN) daily return per active leg.
entry_conditions: Known DOI withdrawal/non-renewal trigger dates from top-5 admitted insurers in FL/CA/LA:
2022-05-31 Allstate non-renewal expansion California
2023-05-26 State Farm halts new homeowner policies California
2023-06-09 Farmers withdrawal Florida (~100k policies)
2023-07-13 Allstate non-renewal California Personal Property
2024-03-20 State Farm 72k California non-renewals
2024-07-15 Liberty Mutual Florida coastal exit announcement
Open long AIZ + short PHM/LEN basket at next-day open after each trigger
exit_conditions: 90 trading days after entry per leg

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance AIZ (long leg), PHM, LEN (short basket), ESNT, MTG (private MI reference), SPY (benchmark)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: SERFF public filings + state DOI press releases. Trigger dates pre-curated from public news + DOI announcements. Forward-run requires SERFF scraper.

backtest_approach: Event study over 6 curated trigger dates 2022-2024. For each trigger, build 90-trading-day forward PnL = AIZ_return - 0.5*(PHM_return + LEN_return). Concat into daily PnL series for portfolio equity curve. Report event-level mean spread + t-stat + Sharpe. Benchmark vs SPY pair (long SPY / short SPY = 0).

Citizens Property Insurance Corp is a public-benefit corp, not publicly traded -- excluded. Small-N event study (6 events) -> report wide confidence intervals. ESNT/MTG retained in tickers list for reference even though strategy doesn't trade them in this version (family enumeration downstream may swap in MI leg).

name: USACE Upper Mississippi Lock Cluster Closure -> Long UNP/CF, Short ADM/BG
rule: Monitor USACE Lock Performance Monitoring System (LPMS) weekly closure logs for Upper Mississippi locks 22, 24, 25 and L&D 27 St. Louis, plus Illinois River LaGrange and Peoria. Detect cluster events: 3+ separate closure events of >72-hour duration each occurring on these locks within any rolling 14-day window. When the cluster condition fires, open a long basket {UNP, CF} (1.5% NAV equal $-weight) against a short basket {ADM, BG} (1.5% NAV equal $-weight). Hold for 30 calendar days or exit early when LPMS reports lockages returning to within 1-sigma of 4-week trailing average.
entry_conditions: USACE LPMS shows 3 or more distinct >72-hour closure events on Upper Mississippi locks (L&D 22, 24, 25, 27, LaGrange, Peoria) within a rolling 14-day window
Open at the close of the trading session following LPMS confirmation
Long basket: UNP, CF each +0.75% NAV (sum +1.5% gross long)
Short basket: ADM, BG each -0.75% NAV (sum -1.5% gross short)
exit_conditions: Exit early when LPMS shows weekly L&D 27 St. Louis tonnage return to within 1 standard deviation of 4-week trailing mean
Hard time stop: 56 calendar days (8 weeks)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: UNP, CF, ADM, BG, SPY (daily close)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: USACE Lock Performance Monitoring System CSV via corpslocks.usace.army.mil/lpwb (free); USDA AMS Grain Transportation Report weekly (free, ams.usda.gov); STB weekly carloadings (free, stb.gov)

backtest_approach: Event-study. (1) Pull historical USACE LPMS lockage and stoppage CSV 2010-2025. (2) Build a rolling 14-day window cluster detector for Upper Miss locks. (3) Identify trigger dates (expect ~5-15 events over 15 years, e.g. Aug-Sep 2022 low water and L&D 25 emergency closures). (4) For each event, simulate basket entry at next-session close; mark daily PnL for up to 56 days or until exit. (5) Compute mean event return, Sharpe, hit rate; compare against SPY.

name: Laredo/Otay Truck Wait > 95th pct -> Short F/GM/STLA Auto OEMs, Long UNP/EWW
rule: Use CBP Border Wait Times API (bwt.cbp.gov) daily commercial-vehicle dwell-time data for Laredo World Trade Bridge and Otay Mesa. Compute 5-day rolling average commercial-truck wait time at each. When either port's 5-day rolling wait exceeds the trailing 12-month 95th percentile (or, as a fixed-threshold fallback, exceeds 150 minutes for >=3 consecutive days), open a short basket {F, GM, STLA, APTV, LEA, BWA} (2.0% NAV equal $-weight short) against a long basket {UNP, EWW} (1.0% NAV equal $-weight long). Hold 21 calendar days or exit early when 5-day rolling wait returns below the 75th percentile.
entry_conditions: 5-day rolling avg commercial-truck wait at Laredo WTB OR Otay Mesa exceeds trailing 12-month 95th percentile (or > 150 min for 3 consecutive days as fallback)
Open at next session close after threshold confirmation
Short basket: F, GM, STLA, APTV, LEA, BWA each ~-0.333% NAV (sum -2.0% gross short)
Long basket: UNP +0.5% NAV, EWW +0.5% NAV (sum +1.0% gross long)
exit_conditions: Exit early when 5-day rolling wait drops below trailing 12-month 75th percentile

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: F, GM, STLA, APTV, LEA, BWA, UNP, EWW, SPY (daily close)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: CBP Border Wait Times API at bwt.cbp.gov (real-time JSON, free; historical archive via Wayback Machine for older periods); BTS Border Crossing/Entry Data monthly CSV at bts.gov (free)

backtest_approach: Event-study with rolling threshold trigger. (1) Pull historical Laredo WTB and Otay Mesa commercial-truck wait data from BTS / CBP archives 2018-2025 (real-time CBP feed is only retained ~30 days, but BTS publishes monthly aggregates; Wayback Machine snapshots fill the daily gap for major events). (2) Build 5-day rolling avg and trailing 12-month 95th-percentile threshold. (3) Identify trigger dates (expect ~10-20 events 2018-2025: e.g. Sep 2023 Eagle Pass/Laredo CBP closures, Nov 2021 Texas SB4 inspection surge). (4) Simulate basket entry at next-session close; mark daily PnL for up to 42 days or until exit. (5) Compute mean event return, Sharpe, hit rate; compare to SPY.
known_events: 2021-04 (Texas SB4 commercial-vehicle inspection surge at Laredo)
2022-04 (Operation Lone Star secondary inspections)
2023-09 (Eagle Pass / Laredo CBP rail-crossing closures, auto-supply disruption)
implementation_notes: MXN volatility leg from the original idea is dropped because backtester is US-equity-focused; EWW (iShares MSCI Mexico ETF) substitutes as a Mexico/maquila proxy. KSU (Kansas City Southern) was acquired by Canadian Pacific in late 2021 forming CP (now CPKC); UNP is retained as the Class-I rail with cross-border switching exposure since CPKC/CP yfinance history is more discontinuous post-merger. CBP historical wait-time data has gaps; backtester may need to splice BTS monthly aggregates with available Wayback Machine snapshots. Trigger condition uses 95th percentile rolling threshold to keep N tractable.

name: TIC Foreign Net Equity Outflow + SPY Near ATH -> Defensive Rotation (Short SPY / Long GLD+TLT)
rule: On Treasury TIC monthly release dates, compute the rolling 2-month sum of net foreign purchases of US corporate stocks (TIC Form S, Table B5b). When the 2-month sum is negative AND SPY close on the release date is within 3% of trailing 252-day high, enter: short SPY (-0.5), long GLD (+0.25), long TLT (+0.25). Hold 60 trading days (~12 weeks) or exit early if SPY closes >+3% above signal-date close. Counter-signal to long_SPY.
entry_conditions: Curated trigger dates: TIC Form S B5b 2-month rolling sum negative AND SPY within 3% of 252d high on the TIC release date
Entry first trading day after TIC release date
Positions: -0.5 SPY, +0.25 GLD, +0.25 TLT (net dollar exposure = 0)
exit_conditions: Exit 60 trading days after entry (~12 weeks)
Early exit if SPY closes >+3% above signal-date close (stop)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: SPY, GLD, TLT, QQQ (audit only)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Hardcoded TIC Form S B5b trigger release dates from US Treasury TIC archive (https://home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system)

backtest_approach: Curated event-date study. Trigger dates correspond to historical TIC Form S B5b 2-month outflow + SPY-near-ATH episodes (a small set: ~6-10 since 2003). For each trigger, daily PnL = -0.5*SPY_ret + 0.25*GLD_ret + 0.25*TLT_ret. Hold 60 trading days unless SPY rallies >3% above entry close (early exit). Concatenate event windows, compute Sharpe/CAGR/MaxDD via harness.compute_metrics with SPY benchmark.
implementation_notes: TIC data is free at https://home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system (Table S/B5b). Trigger dates hardcoded from public archive (manually curated; same pattern as PL262, PL398, PL520). Sample size ~9 events post-2007 — flag as moderate-n. Counter_signal: this is a short-SPY rotation trade that fights the catalog's long-SPY skew when foreign marginal buyer leaves while SPY makes ATH. SPY appears in tickers (already the asset shorted) and as benchmark.

name: SP500 Top-5 Concentration Extreme -> Long RSP / Short SPY (Equal-Weight Mean Reversion)
rule: On curated trigger dates when SP500 top-5 market-cap share crossed >27% (95th percentile since 1990) AND SPY trailing-12-month return was >+20%, enter long RSP / short SPY pair (net dollar-neutral: +1.0 RSP, -1.0 SPY). Hold for 189 trading days (~9 months) or exit early if RSP/SPY ratio drops 5% from entry. Counter-signal to long_SPY.
entry_conditions: Curated trigger dates from S&P Dow Jones Indices / cross-referenced top-5 SPY holdings cap-share crossing 27%
AND SPY 252-day total return > +20% at trigger
Entry: +1.0 RSP, -1.0 SPY (dollar-neutral pair)
exit_conditions: Exit 189 trading days (~9 months) after entry
Early exit if (RSP/SPY ratio) closes 5% below ratio at entry (stop)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Hardcoded top-5 concentration trigger dates from S&P Dow Jones Indices factsheets + computed from top SPY holdings market caps

backtest_approach: Curated event-date pair-trade study. RSP launched Apr 2003, so trigger window is 2003+. For each qualifying trigger date (top-5 weight >27% AND SPY 12m return >20%), daily PnL = RSP_ret - SPY_ret, hold 189 trading days. Concatenate event windows, compute Sharpe/CAGR/MaxDD via harness.compute_metrics with SPY benchmark. Optional stop: exit if cumulative pair PnL drops below -5% intra-window.
implementation_notes: RSP (Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF) inception Apr 2003 — limits sample to 2003+. Trigger dates are curated based on top-5 weight crossing 27% (manually verified from S&P Dow Jones factsheets and SPY top holdings YE prints). Sample size ~7 events — moderate. Counter_signal: counters long_SPY by trading the equal-weight version. SPY appears as both the short leg and benchmark (intentional — measures pair PnL vs SPY).

name: FDA End-of-Phase-2 / Type B Meeting 8-K -> Biotech Phase-3 Alignment Drift
rule: Event study on 8-K filings disclosing FDA End-of-Phase-2 or Type B meeting alignment on Phase 3 design (keywords: 'End-of-Phase 2', 'Type B meeting', 'FDA alignment on Phase 3', 'agreed registrational study design'). For each event: at T+0 (8-K release day) close, if sponsor 30-day prior return < +30% (filter out chase), open LONG sponsor; hold 30 trading days; close at T+30 close. Equal weight across simultaneously-open legs. Daily PnL = avg daily return of open legs.
entry_conditions: 8-K filed with 'End-of-Phase 2' / 'Type B meeting' / 'FDA-aligned Phase 3' keywords
Sponsor 30-day prior return < +30% (anti-chase filter)
Sponsor market cap between $200M and $10B at event date
Open LONG at T+0 close (event day close fill)

backtest_approach: Event-study aggregation across historical EOP2 alignment 8-Ks. For each event compute 30-trading-day forward return path of sponsor. Build daily PnL as equal-weighted basket of simultaneously-open legs. Report avg event return, hit rate, Sharpe, vs XBI/IBB matched-window return.

Open LONG OEM at T+1 close (day after disclosure)
