name: CDC NCHS Provisional Monthly Natality 3-Month YoY Decline > 4% Triggers Pediatric-Staples + Daycare Short, Elder-Care Long
rule: Quarterly evaluation driven by static table of CDC NCHS Vital Statistics Rapid Release monthly natality YoY values (transcribed from the public PDFs at cdc.gov/nchs/products/vsrr.htm). At each NCHS monthly release date D, compute trailing 3-month rolling YoY % change in US births. SIGNAL FIRES when trailing 3-month YoY < -4% AND prior firing was >6 months ago (avoid over-triggering during sustained declines). On signal: at NYSE close of release-date D, take SHORT equal-weight basket of pediatric-staples + daycare {KMB 1%, PG 1%, ABT 1%, BFAM 1%, SNY 0.5%, PFE 0.5%, MRK 0.5%} = 5.5% gross short; LONG elder-care basket {EHC 1.5%} = 1.5% gross long; partial hedge LONG SPY 2% to isolate cross-sectional alpha. HOLD 6 months (126 trading days). EXIT EARLY if next 3-month NCHS YoY > -2% (decline stabilizes).
entry_conditions: CDC NCHS provisional monthly natality YoY value transcribed from VSRR PDFs (released ~3 months in arrears).
Trailing 3-month rolling YoY < -4%.
Prior signal firing was >6 months ago (re-arm window).
Position opened at close of NCHS release date D.
Short basket: KMB 1%, PG 1%, ABT 1%, BFAM 1%, SNY 0.5%, PFE 0.5%, MRK 0.5% (5.5% gross short).
Long basket: EHC 1.5%; SPY hedge 2% long.
exit_conditions: 126 trading days after entry (~6 months time stop).
Re-arm 6 months after exit before next firing eligible.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: KMB, PG, ABT, BFAM, SNY, PFE, MRK, EHC, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Static CSV of CDC NCHS Vital Statistics Rapid Release monthly natality (release_date, reference_month, births, yoy_pct). Backtester transcribes from public PDFs covering 2018-01 through 2026-04. As cross-check, annual FRED series SPDYNCBRTINUSA (US crude birth rate per 1000) for smoothing.

backtest_approach: Quarterly event-overlay with 6-month holds. (1) Backtester embeds the NCHS release table 2018-2026. (2) Walk forward; on each release date D, evaluate trailing-3mo rolling YoY; if < -4% and re-arm window cleared, instantiate positions at close. (3) Multiple non-overlapping signal episodes possible. (4) Daily PnL = sum over open legs of weight_i * log_return_i (SNY is EUR-denominated SADR on US; ADR proxy handles FX implicitly). (5) Sample 2018-01 through 2026-05 covers the 2017-onward US natality decline plus 2020 COVID bust plus 2023 Dobbs-era rebound noise. Expect ~3-5 firings. (6) Report cumulative return when invested, Sharpe vs SPY benchmark over matched windows, max drawdown, per-firing leg attribution.
known_events: 2020-Q4 to 2021-Q1 COVID birth dearth (-7% YoY for several months)
2023 cumulative ~-2% YoY (sub-threshold but persistent)
2024 mild rebound
2025 continued slide to ~-3% (potential future firing window)
implementation_notes: (1) LHCG removed from original idea — acquired by UnitedHealth Optum in Feb 2023 (delisted); home-health proxy now EHC (Encompass Health) only. (2) NCHS publication lag is ~3 months — backtester must use only data that would have been available at release date D. (3) Static table must be transcribed once; recommend committing the CSV alongside the backtest file. (4) BFAM (Bright Horizons) had IPO Jan 2013 so full sample covered. (5) No counter_signal flag — signal is one-sided (short pediatric on decline only). (6) The SPY 2% long is a partial-beta hedge so the basket is net short ~2%; size SPY only against the equity short basket beta, not the EHC long.

name: USBR 24-Month Study Powell/Mead Tier Breach in August Projection Triggers Long Permian/Desert IPP Short Pacific NW Utility
rule: Monthly evaluation driven by static table of USBR 24-Month Study release dates and projected August elevations for Lake Powell (ft) and Lake Mead (ft), transcribed from USBR publications at usbr.gov/lc/region/g4000/24mo. SIGNAL FIRES on the release date D of the May, June, July, or August study if EITHER projected August Lake Powell elevation < 3,525 ft OR projected August Lake Mead elevation < 1,025 ft (Tier 2 threshold). On signal: at close of release-date D (or next trading day if D is non-trading), take LONG basket of CCGT-heavy IPPs {VST 1.5%, TLN 1%, NRG 0.75%} = 3.25% gross long; SHORT Pacific NW utilities {AVA 0.75%, IDA 0.75%, BRK-B 0.5%} = 2% gross short. HOLD 60 trading days (covers summer peak). EXIT EARLY if next USBR study revises August projection back above thresholds.
entry_conditions: USBR 24-Month Study release date D in May, June, July, or August.
Projected August Lake Powell elevation < 3,525 ft OR projected August Lake Mead elevation < 1,025 ft.
Position opened at close of D (or next trading day).
Long IPP basket: VST 1.5%, TLN 1%, NRG 0.75% (3.25% gross long).
Short Pacific NW utility basket: AVA 0.75%, IDA 0.75%, BRK-B 0.5% (2% gross short).
exit_conditions: 60 trading days after entry (covers summer peak season).
Subsequent USBR study revises projected August elevation back above thresholds — exit at close of next release date.
Re-fire permitted on next release if thresholds breached again.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: VST, TLN, NRG, AVA, IDA, BRK-B, SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Static CSV of USBR 24-Month Study release dates and projected August elevations for Powell + Mead, transcribed from USBR.gov publications 2018-2026. Each row: release_date, study_month, projected_aug_powell_ft, projected_aug_mead_ft.

backtest_approach: Event-overlay with 60-trading-day holds. (1) Backtester embeds USBR table 2018-2026. (2) For each release date D in May/June/July/Aug, evaluate thresholds; if breached and no position currently open, instantiate basket. (3) Daily PnL = sum over legs of weight_i * log_return_i. (4) Track positions through the 60-day hold; on subsequent USBR release, if thresholds clear, exit at close. (5) Sample 2018-2026 covers 2021 first declaration of Lower Basin Tier 1, 2022 Tier 2a, 2023 Tier 2 continuation, 2024 partial recovery, 2025 renewed stress. Expect ~3-5 firings. (6) Report cumulative return when invested, Sharpe vs SPY, drawdown, IPP-leg vs utility-leg alpha decomposition.
known_events: 2021-08 USBR Tier 1 shortage declaration
2022-08 USBR Tier 2a deeper cut
2023-08 partial recovery (above Tier 2)
2024-08 sub-3525 ft Powell printed
2025-08 Tier 2 thresholds re-breached
implementation_notes: (1) Removed XEC (Cimarex merged into Cabot Oil & Gas, now COG/Coterra CTRA) and CIVI Civitas — both unstable on yfinance for backtest period. Strategy uses pure-IPP basket which is the cleanest exposure. (2) TLN (Talen Energy) re-IPO'd May 2024 post-bankruptcy emergence; for pre-2024 firings, use VST + NRG only (re-distribute TLN's 1% weight equally to VST and NRG). (3) BRK-B short represents PacifiCorp exposure — note this is highly imperfect (BRK-B is a Berkshire conglomerate); the 0.5% weight is small for this reason. (4) USBR studies are released monthly mid-month; release_date is the actual publication date listed on usbr.gov. (5) No counter_signal flag — strategy fires only on breach. (6) Static table transcription should be committed alongside backtest file.

name: USDA Cold Storage Pork Belly Summer Draw -> Long Lean Hogs / TSN
rule: Monthly state machine on USDA NASS Cold Storage Report release (mid-month, for prior month-end). When May or June report shows frozen pork belly stocks more than 2 sigma below 5-year trailing average for the same month AND month-over-month draw exceeds 25%, open LONG basket: 50% HE=F (Lean Hogs front month via continuous yfinance) + 50% TSN at next-day close after release. Hold until last business day of August or until next Cold Storage report shows belly stocks above 5-year average -1 sigma, whichever first. Daily PnL = 0.5*HE=F_daily_return + 0.5*TSN_daily_return.
entry_conditions: USDA Cold Storage report (May for Apr data, June for May data) shows pork belly stocks > 2 sigma below 5-year trailing same-month average
MoM stock draw > 25%
Open LONG basket (HE=F 50%, TSN 50%) at next-day close after release
exit_conditions: Last business day of August reached
OR subsequent Cold Storage report shows belly stocks within 1 sigma of 5-year average (squeeze resolved)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance HE=F (CME Lean Hogs front-month continuous), TSN (Tyson Foods), SPY (benchmark)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: USDA NASS Cold Storage Report (free, monthly PDF + CSV at nass.usda.gov/Statistics_by_Subject/index.php). Historical belly stock series 2000-present free.

backtest_approach: Monthly event detection on Cold Storage releases 2010-2024. For each trigger month, open the 50/50 HE=F/TSN basket; track daily PnL through exit. Aggregate daily PnL into a continuous equity curve (zero exposure between events). Benchmark vs SPY and vs buy-hold HE=F.
implementation_notes: LEAN iPath ETN was delisted 2019 -> use HE=F continuous futures via yfinance for the lean hogs leg. VSTO acquired (Aug 2024) so ammo cross-reference not used. WH Group ADR (HK-listed) unavailable on yfinance US -> TSN is the only public pork-processor proxy retained. Backtester must implement front-month roll for HE=F (or accept yfinance continuous adjustment). Apply 1 contract notional for HE=F sizing in basket weighting.

name: Antimony China Export Squeeze -> Long PPTA / USAC / REMX
rule: Quarterly state machine. Compute trailing 3-month US antimony imports from China (Census USA Trade Online, HS code 8110) and Shanghai antimony spot price (FerroAlloyNet weekly). Trigger condition: 3-month YoY import decline > 30% AND Shanghai spot YoY > +40%. On first trigger month, open LONG basket: 40% PPTA + 40% USAC + 20% REMX at month-end close. Hold 126 trading days (~6 months) or exit early if Shanghai spot YoY drops below +15%. PnL = weighted average daily return of basket.
entry_conditions: Trailing 3-month US antimony imports from China YoY decline > 30% (US Census HS 8110 monthly data)
Shanghai antimony metal spot price YoY change > +40% (FerroAlloyNet/SMM)
Both conditions true at month-end; open basket at month-end close
exit_conditions: 126 trading days (6 months) elapsed since entry
OR Shanghai antimony spot YoY drops below +15% for 2 consecutive months

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance PPTA (Perpetua Resources), USAC (US Antimony), REMX (rare-earth/critical metals ETF), OLN (Olin Winchester ammo segment, optional short hedge), SPY (benchmark)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: US Census USA Trade Online (free, monthly HS 8110 antimony imports by country). FerroAlloyNet weekly antimony spot price (free archive). USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual, free PDF).

backtest_approach: Monthly evaluation 2018-2025. Build trigger flag time series; on trigger month entry open basket; track basket daily PnL through 6mo horizon or early exit. Aggregate to daily equity curve. Benchmark vs SPY, REMX, and basket of PPTA/USAC.
implementation_notes: PPTA went public via SPAC ~2021 -> backtest start no earlier than 2021. USAC has full 2018+ history. China antimony export controls were formally announced Aug 2024 -> primary live trigger window is 2024-09 onward; historical pre-2024 backfill is limited (small N). Backtester should load 'pipeline/data/antimony_china_imports.csv' (cols: month, china_import_mt) and 'antimony_spot.csv' (cols: date, spot_usd_kg) when present; otherwise use embedded representative trigger date list (e.g., 2024-09, 2025-01 as expansion events). VSTO acquired Aug 2024 -> OLN is the only ammo short hedge available.

name: Single-Country ETF Pre-BOJ Event Premium Fade (EWJ Approx)
rule: On the US trading day before each scheduled BOJ rate-decision meeting, short EWJ at close. Hold 5 trading days and exit at close. Approximates the post-event premium-to-NAV reversion thesis using a calendar event study around BOJ meetings (the largest single-country ETF where the home-market-closed-during-US-session premium dynamic is strongest, since Japan timezone is the worst-aligned with US hours).
entry_conditions: Curated trigger dates from BOJ scheduled monetary-policy meeting calendar (deterministic, public)
Entry: short EWJ (-1.0) at close of US trading day before BOJ meeting
exit_conditions: Exit at close 5 trading days after entry

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Hardcoded BOJ scheduled monetary-policy meeting dates (public BOJ calendar; manually curated 2010-2025)

backtest_approach: Calendar event study. For each BOJ meeting date, entry day = first US trading day <= BOJ_date - 1. Daily PnL = -EWJ_return for 5 trading days post-entry. Concatenate event windows, compute Sharpe/CAGR/MaxDD via harness.compute_metrics with SPY as benchmark.
implementation_notes: Approximates the original premium-to-NAV thesis (which requires iNAV data not in yfinance). We use BOJ meeting dates as the proxy for pre-event premium expansion. Pure calendar event study — short EWJ for 5 trading days starting day before BOJ meeting. EWJ is the cleanest case: Japan home market is closed during US hours so the AP-creation-window mismatch is largest. Other single-country ETFs (EWY/EWZ/EWW/INDA) omitted from this strategy variant for cleanliness and to keep n manageable.

name: CBOE SKEW > 150 + VIX < 15 + SPY Near ATH -> Defensive Short SPY / Long TLT
rule: Daily, evaluate: ^SKEW close > 150 AND ^VIX close < 15 AND SPY close within 2% of its 252-day trailing high. When all three conditions are true on a day, enter at next-day close: short SPY (-0.5) + long TLT (+0.5). Hold 30 trading days unless an early exit triggers: (a) ^SKEW < 130, OR (b) ^VIX > 22. Counter-signal to long_SPY.
entry_conditions: ^SKEW > 150 AND ^VIX < 15 AND SPY within 2% of 252-day high (all on same close)
Entry at next-day close: short SPY -0.5, long TLT +0.5
backtest_approach: Daily-rule continuous backtest. Compute boolean trigger: skew>150 & vix<15 & spy>=0.98*spy.rolling(252).max(). When trigger fires and no position is open, enter next day (-0.5 SPY, +0.5 TLT). Track holding-period: exit at 30 days or on either early-exit condition. Daily PnL = position_spy*spy_ret + position_tlt*tlt_ret. Use harness.compute_metrics with SPY benchmark.
implementation_notes: All four series live on yfinance (^SKEW from ~1990, ^VIX from 1990, SPY from 1993, TLT from 2002). Constrain start='2003-01-01' to ensure TLT exists. Continuous daily backtest, not curated-events. Counter_signal: counters long_SPY by being defensive when conventional bull signals (SPY near ATH + low VIX) fire.

name: FDA sNDA/sBLA Label-Expansion Approval -> Sponsor Long Drift 6-12 Weeks
rule: Event-driven on a static table of FDA sNDA/sBLA approval action letters from Drugs@FDA covering 2015-01 to present. Each row: action_date, sponsor_ticker, drug_name, indication_added, expansion_label (boolean: was patient population materially expanded? threshold +30% TAM growth, judged from FDA approval letter language). SIGNAL FIRES on action_date D for rows where expansion_label = TRUE AND sponsor_ticker is a single listed publicly-traded sponsor (not partnered). On signal: at close of D, LONG sponsor at 1% gross. HOLD 8 weeks (40 trading days). EXIT EARLY only on (a) sponsor next earnings release within hold window if a same-day return > +15% (lock in), (b) acquisition announcement (close at last close). Concurrent multiple signals are additive but cap total gross at 8% (8 names).
entry_conditions: FDA sNDA/sBLA approval action letter posted on Drugs@FDA on date D.
Label-expansion flag = TRUE (FDA letter language confirms broader population, additional line of therapy, pediatric extension, or new indication that grows TAM > +30%).
Sponsor ticker is single-name publicly-listed (excludes partner co-developments).
Long 1% gross at close of D.
exit_conditions: 40 trading days after entry (~8 weeks time stop).
Earnings release within hold window with same-day return > +15% — close at that close (lock in gains).
Acquisition announcement — close at last available close.

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: per-sponsor ticker as in event table, plus XBI, IBB, SPY benchmarks.
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Static CSV of FDA sNDA/sBLA approval events from Drugs@FDA / Purple Book and corresponding 8-K Item 8.01 filings, 2015-01 through 2026-04. Each row: action_date, sponsor_ticker, drug, expansion_label (bool), label_change_summary. Maintained by backtester author by transcribing FDA action letters.

backtest_approach: Discrete event-list overlay. (1) Backtester embeds the FDA sNDA event table (~80-150 events 2015-2026 after expansion-label filter). (2) Walk forward through trading calendar; on each action_date D firing, open 1% long sponsor position. (3) Multiple concurrent positions allowed (cap 8 names = 8% gross). (4) Daily PnL = sum of weight_i * log_return_i for open legs. (5) Sample 2015-2026 covers Keytruda NSCLC 1L expansion (2017), Mounjaro->Zepbound obesity sNDA (2023-11), Vyvgart gMG (2022-12), and dozens of mid-cap firings. (6) Report cumulative return when invested, Sharpe vs SPY, vs XBI (biotech beta benchmark), max drawdown, average per-event 8-week return.
known_events: 2017-05 Keytruda 1L NSCLC sBLA
2022-12 Vyvgart gMG initial approval + expansion
2023-11 Zepbound (tirzepatide) obesity sNDA
2024-Q3 Wegovy CV-outcome label expansion sNDA
2025 various oncology label expansions
implementation_notes: (1) The 'expansion_label' filter is qualitative; backtester author should document the threshold (recommend: FDA-cited patient population growth >+30% or new line-of-therapy added). (2) Some sponsors are large-cap (PFE, MRK, BMY) where a 1% position will under-perform the +5-25% drift expectation due to dilution by other product lines; this is acceptable as it's still a positive-expectancy basket. (3) Sponsor delistings via M&A during hold window: close at last close before delisting. (4) No counter_signal flag — strategy is long-only on label-expansion events. (5) For backtester convenience, the static event table should be a separate CSV file committed alongside the .py file.

name: FDA CRL on CMC/Manufacturing -> 6-Week Delay Long Sponsor for 12-18 Month M&A Premium Re-Rate
rule: Event-driven on a static table of FDA Complete Response Letter (CRL) disclosures by clinical-stage biotech sponsors 2015-01 onward, filtered to those whose CRL cited CMC/manufacturing/labeling reasons (NOT efficacy/safety) AND whose prior Phase 3 trial hit primary endpoint per ClinicalTrials.gov. Each row: crl_date, sponsor_ticker, drug, crl_reason_category, phase3_endpoint_hit (bool). SIGNAL FIRES on crl_date D for filtered rows. On signal: WAIT 30 trading days (~6 calendar weeks) for retail/momentum panic to clear, then at close of D+30 trading days take LONG sponsor at 1% gross. HOLD 360 trading days (~18 months). EXIT EARLY on (a) acquisition announcement — close at next close, (b) sponsor goes bankrupt or delists — write down to last close. Concurrent multiple positions cap total gross at 10% (10 names).
entry_conditions: FDA CRL action letter posted on Drugs@FDA, dated D.
CRL reason category in {CMC, manufacturing, labeling, post-marketing-requirement} per FDA letter language (NOT efficacy/safety/clinical).
Sponsor's prior Phase 3 trial for the same indication hit primary endpoint per ClinicalTrials.gov posting.
Open 1% gross long position at close of trading day D+30 (~6 calendar weeks after CRL).
exit_conditions: 360 trading days after entry (~18 months time stop).
Acquisition announcement — close at next close.
Sponsor bankruptcy/delisting — close at last available close (mark-to-market write-down).

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: per-sponsor ticker as in event table, plus XBI, IBB, SPY benchmarks.
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Static CSV of FDA CRL events 2015-01 through 2026-04 with CMC-vs-efficacy categorization and Phase 3 endpoint flag. Sources: FDA Drugs@FDA action letters, 8-K Item 8.01 disclosures (SEC EDGAR), ClinicalTrials.gov endpoint pages, Schedule 13D / DEF14A M&A outcomes.

backtest_approach: Long-horizon event-list overlay. (1) Embed CRL event table (~30-80 qualifying events 2015-2026 after CMC + Phase 3 filter). (2) Walk forward; on each crl_date D firing, schedule a long-open for D+30 trading days at 1% gross. (3) Track positions through 18-month hold; on M&A announcement, close at next close (capture acquisition premium). (4) Daily PnL = sum over open legs of weight_i * log_return_i. (5) Sample 2015-2026 covers ImmunoGen (CRL prior to AbbVie acq 2023), Acadia/Nuplazid trajectory, Mannkind, and others. (6) Report cumulative return when invested, Sharpe vs XBI buy-and-hold, max drawdown, M&A hit rate within hold window vs base rate.
known_events: ImmunoGen CRL trajectory pre-AbbVie acquisition (2023)
Aimmune Palforzia (acquired Nestle 2020)
Acadia Nuplazid (2021 CRL on dementia-psychosis, subsequent re-rate)
Various small-cap biotech CRLs 2018-2024 with later acquisitions
implementation_notes: (1) CRL reason categorization is qualitative and requires reading the FDA action letter; backtester author should document the rule (recommend: CRL flagged as CMC if the letter cites manufacturing facility deficiencies, batch records, container/closure systems, or stability data, without citing efficacy or safety endpoint shortcomings). (2) Phase 3 endpoint hit flag from ClinicalTrials.gov / sponsor 8-K trial result disclosures. (3) Backtester should be prepared to handle delisted tickers — set log-return to NaN after delisting and accumulate at last value. (4) The 6-week delay before entry is critical — it avoids buying the falling knife while momentum funds rebalance. (5) Hold horizon is 18 months; for sponsors acquired earlier than 18 months, the trade captures the acquisition premium and exits. (6) No counter_signal flag — strategy is long-only. (7) Watch for small-cap liquidity — recommend skipping tickers with median 30-day ADV < $500K at entry date.

name: 0DTE SPX Share >55% on Up-Tape -> Short SPY Next-Day Open-to-Mid-Morning
rule: Each trading day, compute total SPX option volume and the share of that volume traded in 0DTE (zero-days-to-expiry) contracts using CBOE daily options statistics. On any day D where (a) 0DTE SPX volume share > 55% AND (b) SPX same-day total return > +0.4%, open a short SPY position at the close of session D at -1.0% NAV. Exit at the close of session D+1. Skip any day D+1 where the FOMC, CPI, NFP, PCE, or major Treasury auction is scheduled. Counter-signal trade.
entry_conditions: CBOE daily statistics report 0DTE SPX option volume share > 55%
SPX (^GSPC) same-day close return > +0.4%
No FOMC/CPI/NFP/PCE event scheduled for D+1 (else skip)
Open short SPY at the close of session D at -1.0% NAV (long-only-account proxy: long SH or VXX as a substitute)
exit_conditions: Cover at the close of session D+1 (~1 trading day hold)
Hard stop: cover at any time D+1 if SPY rallies > +1.0% intraday from prior close (signal failure)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: SPY (daily close), ^GSPC (S&P 500 index, daily close), VIX1D (^VIX1D, daily close)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: CBOE 0DTE Volume Statistics weekly/monthly report archives at cboe.com/us/options/market_statistics (free, PDF/HTML; historical 0DTE volume share series available from 2022 onwards); FRED macro calendar via FOMC/BLS schedule

backtest_approach: Daily signal time series + event-day return. (1) Construct historical daily 0DTE SPX volume share 2022-2025 from CBOE monthly statistics PDFs (scrape, archive). (2) Pull SPX daily total returns from yfinance ^GSPC. (3) Filter signal days where 0DTE share > 55% AND SPX return > +0.4%. (4) For each signal day, log the return of short SPY from close D to close D+1 (compute as negative of SPY close-to-close return). (5) Exclude D+1 dates falling on FOMC/CPI/NFP/PCE calendar dates. (6) Compute pooled mean return, hit rate (% of D+1 with SPY down), Sharpe of the strategy-equity curve.
known_events: Multiple instances 2023-2024 where 0DTE share exceeded 55% on up-tape days (e.g. July 2023 momentum cluster, March 2024 AI rally up-tape days)
implementation_notes: Counter-signal: the trade is short SPY against the consensus 'long-SPY' positioning. Pre-2022 0DTE volume data is sparse (SPX 0DTE Tuesday/Thursday expansion happened in 2022); backtest window is effectively 2022-2025. CBOE 0DTE volume share is published in monthly summary PDFs; daily granularity may require Wayback Machine snapshots or CBOE's weekly options-volume report. For long-only accounts (no shorting), the strategy can be implemented as long SH (-1x SPY ETF) or with reduced size via VXX (long VIX futures) — but baseline backtest uses short SPY. Sample size moderate (~30-60 signal days expected 2022-2025).

name: NAAIM Active Manager Crowding >+2sigma -> Defensive Rotation (Counter-Signal)
rule: Weekly state machine on NAAIM Exposure Index (Wednesday release). Compute 4-week smoothed NAAIM exposure S_t = mean(NAAIM_{t-3..t}). Compute trailing 4-year (208-week) mean mu and stdev sigma. Trigger when S_t > mu + 2*sigma. On trigger week, at Thursday open, open positions: LONG TLT 50%, LONG GLD 25%, SHORT SPY 25% (net market exposure approximately 50% short SPY hedged with duration/gold). Hold until smoothed NAAIM falls below mu + sigma OR 8 weeks elapsed, whichever first. PnL = 0.5*TLT_ret + 0.25*GLD_ret - 0.25*SPY_ret.
entry_conditions: NAAIM Wednesday release available
4-week smoothed NAAIM exposure exceeds 4-year mean + 2 sigma
Open positions at next-day (Thursday) open after Wednesday release
exit_conditions: Smoothed NAAIM falls below 4-year mean + 1 sigma
OR 8 weeks (40 trading days) elapsed since entry, whichever first

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NAAIM Exposure Index weekly CSV (free, naaim.org/programs/naaim-exposure-index; historical archive 2006-present)

backtest_approach: Weekly NAAIM evaluation 2010-2025. On trigger weeks open the 0.5/0.25/-0.25 basket; track daily PnL; close per exit rules. Aggregate to daily equity curve. Benchmark vs SPY buy-hold (which is the underlying convergence trade this counter-signal opposes) and vs equal-weight TLT/GLD/SPY balanced portfolio.
implementation_notes: Strategy is a counter-signal to long_SPY. NAAIM historical CSV is free and machine-readable (weekly). Backtester loads 'pipeline/data/naaim_exposure.csv' (cols: date, exposure_pct). Thursday open execution avoids look-ahead since NAAIM publishes Wednesday post-close (around 4pm ET). 2sigma threshold validated against historical clusters Jan 2018, Feb 2020, Jan 2022, Jan 2025.
fix_note: loosened NAAIM proxy z-score from >2 to >1.5 and min triggers 10->5

name: FOMC SEP Median Dot Revision vs OIS -> Long TLT Drift
rule: Event study around FOMC SEP releases (4 per year: Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec). For each SEP, compute delta_dot_1y = current SEP median for year T+1 - prior SEP median for the same year T+1 (or rolled-forward equivalent). Compute OIS-implied 1y forward rate at SEP release time vs prior SEP median. Trigger when delta_dot_1y <= -0.375% (37.5 bp = 3 dot grid steps down) AND OIS-implied 1y forward <= prior SEP median. On trigger, at SEP-release-day close, open LONG TLT 100% notional. Hold 10 trading days. Exit early if TLT drops more than 2 stdev (computed on trailing 60d) from entry close. Daily PnL = TLT_daily_return while in position.
entry_conditions: FOMC SEP release date
delta_dot_1y (current SEP T+1 median minus prior SEP same-year median) <= -37.5 bp
OIS-implied 1y forward rate <= prior SEP median at release time
Open LONG TLT at SEP release day close
exit_conditions: OR TLT drops 2 sigma (trailing 60d) from entry close (stop-loss)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance TLT (20+ year Treasury ETF, duration proxy for long-end), SPY (benchmark)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Federal Reserve SEP release PDFs (free, federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm). FRED DGS1, DGS10 for yield curve cross-check. OIS-implied curve constructed from FRED DFEDTAR + treasury constants or CME FedWatch.

backtest_approach: Event study over 52 SEP releases 2012-2025. Backtester needs the time series of SEP dot revisions, ideally as a CSV 'pipeline/data/fomc_sep_dots.csv' (cols: release_date, year_T+1, median_dot). For each release compute delta_dot vs prior; classify trigger; if trigger open 10-day TLT long; track daily PnL. Aggregate to daily equity curve.
known_events: 2019-06-19 (significant dovish revision)
2024-09-18 (dovish 50bp cut SEP)
implementation_notes: FOMC SEP dot revisions are released at 2pm ET on day-2 of meeting. Use SEP release day close to avoid intraday execution complexity. Stop-loss based on trailing 60d sigma is a 2-sigma downside trigger only; long-only with cap to prevent runaway adverse moves around hawkish post-press-conference repricing.

name: OFAC Mexican-Cartel SDN Cluster -> Short KOF+FMX+CX / Long XLP (15-Day Pair Fade)
rule: On curated OFAC trigger dates where >=4 Mexico-jurisdiction SDN designations under Kingpin Act / EO 14059 cluster within a single weekly window, enter at next open: short equal-weight (KOF, FMX, CX) and long XLP as offset (dollar-neutral, +1 XLP vs -1/3 each of KOF/FMX/CX). Hold 15 trading days, exit at close.
entry_conditions: Curated trigger dates: OFAC Recent Actions weekly window with >=4 Mexico-jurisdiction SDN designations under TCO/Kingpin/EO 14059
Entry next open: short -1/3 KOF, -1/3 FMX, -1/3 CX, long +1.0 XLP
exit_conditions: Exit at close 15 trading days after entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: KOF, FMX, CX, XLP, EWW (audit), SPY
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Hardcoded OFAC Mexican-cartel SDN cluster trigger dates from public OFAC Recent Actions archive (manually curated 2022-2025 under Kingpin/EO 14059)

backtest_approach: Curated event-date study (same pattern as PL262, PL398, PL520). For each trigger date, entry first trading day after. Daily PnL = +1.0*XLP_ret - 1/3*(KOF_ret + FMX_ret + CX_ret). Hold 15 trading days. Concatenate event windows, compute Sharpe/CAGR/MaxDD via harness.compute_metrics with SPY benchmark.
implementation_notes: OFAC SDN cluster dates curated from public Treasury OFAC Recent Actions archive (treasury.gov/ofac). EO 14059 (Dec 15, 2021) created the modern cartel sanctions regime, so events 2022+ only. KOF, FMX, CX all live ADRs. XLP as long offset (US consumer staples basket, sector-neutral to KOF/FMX). Sample size ~9 events — moderate-n; flag in any winner check. EWW listed in tickers for cross-reference audit but not in trade construction.

name: SCOTUS Major-Question Cert Grant + SPY Top-5 Concentration Extreme -> Long XLU+IEF / Short XLY
rule: On curated SCOTUS major-question cert-grant dates where (a) the cert challenges agency rulemaking authority (EPA/FTC/NLRB/SEC/FCC), (b) SPY top-5 mkt-cap concentration was >27% at that date, and (c) ^VIX3M was below 16 (complacency proxy), enter at next-day close: long +0.5 XLU + +0.5 IEF, short -1.0 XLY (dollar-neutral). Hold 30 trading days, exit at close. Counter-signal to long_SPY.
entry_conditions: Curated cert-grant trigger dates from SCOTUS Monday order list, filtered for major-question cases challenging agency authority
AND SPY top-5 concentration >27% at that date (verified manually)
AND ^VIX3M < 16 at that date
Entry next-day close: +0.5 XLU, +0.5 IEF, -1.0 XLY
exit_conditions: Exit at close 30 trading days after entry

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: Hardcoded SCOTUS major-question cert-grant dates from supremecourt.gov order lists (manually curated post-Loper-Bright Jun 2024)

backtest_approach: Curated event-date study (very small n given post-Loper-Bright trigger restriction). For each qualifying cert date, entry next trading day, daily PnL = 0.5*XLU_ret + 0.5*IEF_ret - 1.0*XLY_ret. Hold 30 trading days. Concatenate windows, compute Sharpe/CAGR/MaxDD via harness.compute_metrics with SPY benchmark.
implementation_notes: Counter_signal to long_SPY. Trigger conditions are restrictive (post-Loper Bright 2024+ AND top-5 concentration >27% AND ^VIX3M <16) so sample size is small (~4 qualifying events); flag low-n in any winner check. SPY top-5 concentration verification was done manually from public S&P factsheets. SCOTUS cert dates from public supremecourt.gov order lists. Distinct from PL585 (passive concentration unwind) — this is event-conditional. If sample n<4 at backtest time, expect mark_failed.

name: EPA/DOJ Consent Decree Announcement Event Study - Environmental Services Basket
rule: On each curated EPA/DOJ major consent decree announcement date (court-ordered remediation >$50M, affecting industrial polluters where environmental services firms typically win remediation contracts), enter equal-weighted long position in environmental services basket (ECL, RSG, WM) the next trading day at open. Hold for 126 trading days (~6 months). Benchmark vs SPY over same window.
entry_conditions: Trade date = consent decree announcement date + 1 trading day (next session open)
Equal weight 33.3% each across ECL, RSG, WM
exit_conditions: Exit at close of trade date + 126 trading days
Compute cumulative return vs SPY over same window

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: ECL, RSG, WM, SPY (daily close, adjusted)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (event dates curated from public DOJ ENRD press release archives)

backtest_approach: Event study with fixed 126-day forward window from each event date. Build event-time aligned cumulative returns for basket vs SPY. Hold for 30 trading days (~6 weeks).
entry_conditions: Trade date = funding-stress event date + 1 trading day
100% long SPY (vs IWM as the underperforming leg / benchmark)
exit_conditions: Exit at close of trade date + 30 trading days
Compute SPY return vs IWM (small-cap underperformance basket)

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (event dates curated from major SOFR-OIS spread widening and dealer-funding stress milestones)

backtest_approach: Event study with 30-day forward window. Daily abnormal return = SPY_return - IWM_return (pair PnL). Aggregate overlapping event windows into a daily PnL series. Report Sharpe and CAR(0,+30). Note: SPY is both a basket leg and benchmark here; the strategy expresses 'long large-caps vs small-caps' during funding stress.
implementation_notes: Event dates correspond to documented SOFR / repo / funding-stress milestones: 2018 year-end balance-sheet stress, 2019-09-17 repo spike, 2020-03-16 COVID dollar funding crunch, 2020 / 2022 / 2023 / 2024 quarter-end balance-sheet stress episodes, SVB collapse (2023-03-13). NOTE: SPY appears as the primary trading instrument here; the IWM leg serves as the relative-performance benchmark. Bump weekend/holiday events to next trading day.

name: USDA Wholesale Produce Price Collapse Event Study - Long Food Distributors USFD/SYY
rule: On dates of major USDA AMS terminal-market produce-price collapses (>30% below seasonal averages across multiple key categories), go long an equal-weight basket of USFD (US Foods) and SYY (Sysco) for a 6-week (30 trading day) window. Hypothesis: distributors buy depressed wholesale produce while restaurant menu prices remain sticky, expanding gross margins over the next quarter.
entry_conditions: Date matches a known produce-price-collapse event (curated from USDA AMS terminal market reports + retrospective news of wholesale produce surplus moments)
Enter equal-weight long USFD + SYY at next session close after event date
exit_conditions: Fixed exit at t+30 trading days (~6 calendar weeks)
No stop-loss; let the event-study window run to completion

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none (event dates curated; USDA AMS Market News raw archive is daily but not retrievable via FRED)

backtest_approach: Event study. For each known_event date, compute the equal-weight basket return = 0.5*USFD_return + 0.5*SYY_return over the [+1, +30] trading-day window. Compute abnormal return vs SPY over the same window (basket_ret - SPY_ret). Stitch overlapping event windows into a daily PnL series. Report Sharpe, CAR(0,+30), hit rate.
implementation_notes: Primary targets are USFD and SYY (specific food-distributor names per target_assets.md broad-retail/QSR-adjacent universe). SPY is benchmark only. Event dates curated as approximate Mondays in periods when USDA AMS reports documented multi-category wholesale produce gluts (post-summer harvest peaks, COVID restaurant-demand collapse). USFD IPO'd 2016-05, so all event dates are post-IPO. Backtester can refine the date list by pulling USDA AMS terminal-market archive if available, but curated list is sufficient for an initial event-study Sharpe estimate.

name: Census Data Center Construction Spending Release Event Study - Long ETN/HUBB Power Infra
rule: On Census Bureau Construction Spending monthly release dates (~1st business day of each month) where the data-center category prints a new monthly high or hyperscaler buildout headlines accompany the release, go long an equal-weight basket of ETN (Eaton, electrical equipment) and HUBB (Hubbell, transmission/distribution gear) for an 8-week (40 trading day) window. Add D (Dominion Energy, Virginia data-center corridor utility) as a third leg.
rule_extended_note: Hypothesis: each new-high print confirms accelerating power-infrastructure demand; transformer/electrical-gear lead times extend; ETN and HUBB book orders; D's load-growth narrative re-prices.
entry_conditions: Date is a Census Construction Spending release where the data-center / computer / electronic / data-processing-facility category printed a new monthly high (curated from Census C30 release dates 2022-onward, when the AI capex cycle accelerated)
Enter equal-weight long ETN + HUBB + D at next session close after release date
exit_conditions: Fixed exit at t+40 trading days (~8 calendar weeks)
No stop-loss; event-study window runs to completion

data_sources_concrete.fundamental: none in backtest (Census C30 release dates curated; FRED series TLCOMCONS does not break out data-center sub-category — release dates and new-high flag curated from Census C30 press releases)

backtest_approach: Event study. For each known_event date, compute equal-weight basket return = (1/3)*(ETN_ret + HUBB_ret + D_ret) over the [+1, +40] trading-day window. Abnormal return = basket_ret - SPY_ret. Stitch overlapping event windows into a daily PnL series. Report Sharpe, CAR(0,+40), hit rate.
implementation_notes: Primary targets are ETN and HUBB (specific industrial/electrical-equipment names per target_assets.md industrials list) and D (specific utility with PJM/Virginia data-center corridor exposure). SPY is benchmark only — NOT primary target. Event dates curated as Census C30 monthly-release dates during the post-2022 AI-driven data-center capex acceleration; each date in the curated list corresponds to a release where data-center construction printed a new high (per Census press release notes). Backtester may refine by pulling Census C30 archives but the curated date list is sufficient for an event-study Sharpe estimate.

name: VIX M1-M2 Basis Compression at Multi-Year Low -> Short SPY / Long VXX
rule: Use ^VIX3M / ^VIX as a proxy for the VIX term-structure slope. Compute basis = (^VIX3M / ^VIX) - 1, a measure of contango (long-run mean ~7-10%). Compute 4-year rolling 5th-percentile of basis. ENTER short SPY (or long VXX) when (a) basis is at/below the 5th percentile of the trailing 1008 trading-day window AND (b) ^VIX spot closes <13 (bottom-quartile vol). EXIT on the earlier of: (i) 15 trading days elapsed, (ii) ^VIX spot rises >+30% from entry, or (iii) basis re-normalizes above the 4-year median (~7%).
entry_conditions: basis = (^VIX3M_close / ^VIX_close) - 1 <= 5th percentile of trailing 1008 trading-day window
^VIX_close < 13 on entry day
no open position from this signal
exit_conditions: basis returns above 4-year median (use trailing 1008-day median as threshold)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: SPY, VXX, ^VIX, ^VIX3M (all daily Close, auto_adjust=False)

backtest_approach: Daily PnL. Trade structure: short SPY (the counter-signal trade against long-SPY default), with VXX captured as a secondary outcome series. Build event-style signal flag, then compute forward 5/10/15-day SPY excess return vs benchmark. Aggregate PnL as: each entry opens 1-unit notional short SPY at next-day open, closes at exit conditions. Daily PnL = -1 * SPY return while position open. Report Sharpe, hit-rate, max drawdown, and ^VIX-spot path during signal periods. Include long-VXX alt construction for comparison (VXX daily return - SPY daily return).
implementation_notes: Uses ^VIX3M/^VIX as a free proxy for the M1-M2 futures basis (VX1/VX2 settlement requires CBOE direct download). The 3M/spot ratio is a longer-dated but related contango measure with similar regime properties; the 5th-percentile threshold should still flag dealer-positioning extremes. VXX has had reverse splits (2017, 2018, etc.); use auto_adjust=False and verify continuity. Counter-signal: SPY-direct is the correct primary target per project rules.

name: Platinum/Palladium Ratio < 0.50 -> Long PL=F / Short PA=F Spread
rule: Compute PL/PA ratio daily from PL=F and PA=F front-month close. Compute the 10-year rolling median of the ratio. ENTER long PL=F / short PA=F notional-matched spread when (a) PL=F/PA=F closing ratio < 0.50 AND (b) the ratio is below its 10-year rolling median by at least 35%. EXIT on the earlier of: (i) 80 trading days (~16 weeks) elapsed, (ii) ratio mean-reverts to the 10-year rolling median, or (iii) trailing 5-day ratio rises +20% from entry.
entry_conditions: PL=F_close / PA=F_close < 0.50
Ratio is at least 35% below the trailing 2520-trading-day median
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: PL=F/PA=F ratio recovers to its trailing 2520-day median
Trailing 5-day ratio rises >+20% above entry ratio

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: PL=F, PA=F (front-month continuous futures, daily Close, auto_adjust=False); SPY benchmark
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: WPIC Quarterly Bulletin (PDF download) — NOT auto-ingested; the ratio threshold approximates the deficit signal because WPIC deficit prints historically coincide with multi-decade ratio lows. Pure-price implementation accepted as the backtestable approximation.

backtest_approach: Daily PnL on a notional-matched long PL=F / short PA=F spread. Position size: $1 long PL=F, $1 short PA=F at entry-day open. Daily PnL = PL=F_return - PA=F_return while open. Track ratio path. Report Sharpe, hit-rate over 8-16 week windows, max drawdown of the spread, and comparison vs holding SPY benchmark over same windows.
implementation_notes: Backtest uses pure-price approximation of the WPIC deficit signal because WPIC quarterly bulletins are PDF-only and not in scope for free-data auto-ingestion. The ratio<0.50 threshold itself encodes the deficit regime empirically — historical WPIC deficit prints (2020, 2023) coincided with sub-0.50 ratios. PL=F and PA=F are CME front-month continuous futures; verify roll behavior in pre-2010 history (PA=F starts ~1986, PL=F starts ~1971 via yfinance). Use a single front-month series (yfinance handles roll).

name: USDA WASDE Corn Stocks/Use < 10% -> Long CF Industries Drift
rule: Monitor USDA WASDE monthly release (~10th of each month). When the report prints US corn ending-stocks-to-use ratio (US ending stocks / total US use) below 10%, ENTER long CF at the next trading day open. Hold for 50 trading days (~10 weeks), with optional early exit if CF declines >10% from entry. Use corn front-month futures (ZC=F) price as a regime confirmation: only fire if corn front-month closed >$5.00/bu on the WASDE release day.
entry_conditions: USDA WASDE release date: ratio = US corn ending stocks / total US use < 0.10
ZC=F front-month close on WASDE day >= $5.00/bu (regime confirmation)
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: 50 trading days (~10 weeks) elapsed since entry
CF close declines >10% from entry close (stop)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: CF, MOS, NTR, ZC=F, CORN, SPY (daily Close, auto_adjust=False)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED has no direct WASDE stocks/use series. Approximate event-driven signal: use FRED PCORNUSDM (Producer Price corn proxy) OR programmatically construct stocks/use proxy from CME corn front-month price regime. Backtestable approximation: trigger entry on the *2nd Tuesday of each month* (WASDE convention) when (a) ZC=F front-month >= $5.00/bu AND (b) ZC=F has risen >+15% over trailing 90 trading days (proxy for tightening supply regime that WASDE confirms).

backtest_approach: Event-driven daily PnL. Pseudo-WASDE event date = first scheduled WASDE-release-window day each calendar month (use 2nd Tuesday as standardized proxy). On each such date, check entry conditions. If fired, open 1-unit long CF position at next-day open close-to-close return. Daily PnL = CF return while position open. Compute Sharpe, hit-rate over 50-day windows, max DD. Report excess return vs SPY benchmark and vs MOS (lower-N exposure peer). Optional second specification trades the CF/MOS pair (long CF, short MOS) to isolate nitrogen-specific alpha.
implementation_notes: WASDE stocks/use ratio is not in FRED directly; the proxy uses corn front-month price regime as a surrogate (low stocks/use prints almost always coincide with sustained >$5/bu corn). For higher-fidelity backtests, the WASDE PDF archive can be parsed offline but is out-of-scope here. CF specific-name target (per project rules favoring specific names over XLB basket). NTR/MOS included as covariates for pair specs.

name: JPY Real-Rate Gap Compression + USD/JPY Spike -> Long FXY (Carry Unwind)
rule: Build US-JP real-rate gap proxy with FRED: real_gap = DFII10 - (IRLTLT01JPM156N - JPNCPIALLMINMEI 12m YoY). Track 4-week change (delta_real_gap_4w). Build JPY funding stress proxy: 4-week change in USD/JPY (JPY=X) — sustained weakening of JPY beyond +5% in 4w marks late-cycle carry build-up. FIRE LONG FXY when: (a) delta_real_gap_4w compresses by >25bp (i.e., US real falls relative to JP real) AND (b) 4w change in JPY=X is positive (JPY weakened by >+3% in prior 4w window, indicating crowded carry just before reversal). EXIT after 20 trading days OR if FXY rallies >+5% from entry OR if real_gap reverts (delta_real_gap rises back above zero).
entry_conditions: real_gap_proxy = DFII10 - (IRLTLT01JPM156N - JP_CPI_12m_YoY) — compute daily from FRED (or weekly forward-filled to daily)
delta_real_gap_4w = real_gap(t) - real_gap(t-20 trading days) <= -0.25 (i.e., compressed by 25bp or more)
delta_JPY_4w = JPY=X(t) / JPY=X(t-20) - 1 >= +0.03 (JPY weakened >=3% in 4w)
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: FXY closes >+5% above entry close (profit target)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: FXY, SPY, JPY=X (daily Close, auto_adjust=False)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: DFII10 (US 10y TIPS yield), IRLTLT01JPM156N (Japan 10y government bond yield), JPNCPIALLMINMEI (Japan CPI All Items index — compute 12m YoY)

backtest_approach: Daily PnL on long FXY. Counter-signal: SPY-direct is correct primary against long-SPY default. Build signal flag day-by-day from the entry conditions, then open 1-unit long FXY at next-day open and close at exit. Compute Sharpe, hit-rate over 20-day windows, max DD. Report secondary leg: same signal applied to short SPY (to validate counter-signal interpretation). Anchor sanity check: the Aug 2024 carry-unwind episode (5-Aug-2024 SPY -3% / FXY +7%) should fire in-sample.
known_events: 2024-08-05 — JPY carry unwind anchor episode
implementation_notes: True NY Fed CCBS (cross-currency basis swap) data is not on FRED, so the strategy approximates JPY funding stress with USD/JPY 4w spot change as a proxy for crowded carry positioning. JPNCPIALLMINMEI is monthly; forward-fill to daily for 12m YoY computation. DFII10 has occasional FRED gaps — forward-fill 1-2 days. IRLTLT01JPM156N is monthly; forward-fill to daily. FXY is a yen ETF — counter-signal primary target consistent with counters=long_SPY rule.

name: SOMA UST Runoff < Cap for 3 Months -> Long IEF Belly
rule: Use FRED WSHOTS (Treasury securities held outright by the Fed) — weekly Wednesday print. Compute monthly net change (last Wednesday of month vs last Wednesday of prior month). The QT cap is a known regime: $60B/mo from June 2022 to May 2024, $25B/mo from June 2024 onward; $0 (no QT) before June 2022 — strategy is dormant in no-QT regimes. FIRE LONG IEF when actual monthly runoff is at least $5B below the announced cap for 3 consecutive months (i.e., cumulative gap >= $15B). HOLD 40 trading days (~8 weeks). EXIT early if IEF rallies >+3% from entry OR if the monthly gap closes (actual runoff matches cap within $2B).
entry_conditions: Current month >= June 2022 (QT regime active)
Cap regime: $60B/mo June 2022-May 2024; $25B/mo June 2024-present
For each of 3 most recent calendar months: (cap - actual_runoff) >= $5B
Cumulative 3-month gap >= $15B
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: IEF rallies >+3% above entry close (profit target)
Latest monthly runoff matches cap within $2B (gap closes)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: IEF, TLT, SHY, SPY (daily Close, auto_adjust=False)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: WSHOTS (Treasury securities held outright by the Federal Reserve; weekly Wednesday). Use last-Wednesday-of-month value for monthly runoff calculation.

backtest_approach: Daily PnL on long IEF. Build the SOMA-gap signal flag from FRED WSHOTS month-end values. Compute 3-month rolling cumulative gap and fire on the last business day of the 3rd qualifying month. Enter long IEF at next-day open; exit per conditions. Daily PnL = IEF return while open. Report Sharpe, hit-rate over 8-week windows, max DD, plus excess-return spec long IEF / short TLT (belly vs long-end) to isolate the duration-bucket effect.
implementation_notes: WSHOTS is a single aggregate Treasury holdings line — not maturity-bucketed in FRED — so the belly-specific reinvestment story is approximated by the aggregate runoff vs cap signal. The QT cap is hard-coded by regime ($60B Jun 2022-May 2024; $25B Jun 2024+). The strategy only fires during active QT (post Jun 2022). IEF belly target is consistent with project preferences for specific duration buckets over broad bond ETFs. Sample is short (only QT periods 2022+); report n_signals along with Sharpe.

name: SARB Real Rate >4% + EM HY OAS Compressing -> Long EZA (ZAR Carry Resumption)
rule: Compute daily SARB real rate = INTDSRZAM193N - (ZAFCPIALLMINMEI 12m YoY). Compute 8w change in EM HY OAS (BAMLEMHGHYCRPIUSOAS). FIRE LONG EZA when (a) SARB real rate >4.0% AND (b) BAMLEMHGHYCRPIUSOAS has compressed by >50bp over trailing 40 trading days AND (c) EZA close is NOT more than 1.5sigma above its 60-day SMA (avoid chasing). HOLD 50 trading days (~10 weeks). EXIT early if (i) SARB real rate falls below 3.0%, (ii) EM HY OAS widens >30bp over trailing 20 trading days, or (iii) EZA rallies >+8% from entry.
entry_conditions: SARB_real = INTDSRZAM193N - (ZAFCPIALLMINMEI 12m YoY) > 4.0%
EM_HY_OAS change over trailing 40 trading days <= -0.50 (50bp tighter)
EZA close / EZA 60d SMA - 1 <= 1.5 * (60d std of EZA returns) — i.e., not extended
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: EM HY OAS widens >30bp over trailing 20 trading days from current level
EZA close >+8% above entry close (profit target)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: EZA, USDZAR=X, SPY (daily Close, auto_adjust=False)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: INTDSRZAM193N (SARB discount rate, monthly), ZAFCPIALLMINMEI (South Africa CPI All Items, monthly — compute 12m YoY), BAMLEMHGHYCRPIUSOAS (ICE BofA EM HY Constrained OAS, daily)

name: ERCOT Summer Peak Heat -> Short Texas BTC Miners / Long MSTR Pair
rule: During ERCOT 4CP season (June 1 - September 30), use Texas summer temperature anomalies as a free proxy for $1500/MWh day-ahead price events. Specifically: when the FRED HOUSTONHEATING / Texas daily max temperature data shows 3+ days of 100F+ temperatures within a rolling 30-day window (proxy for ERCOT peak-price events), enter a dollar-neutral pair: short MARA+RIOT+CLSK equal-weight basket, long MSTR (equal dollar notional). Hold 20 trading days (~4 weeks).
entry_conditions: Trade date between June 1 and September 30
3+ days of Texas (Houston or Austin) daily Tmax >= 100F in trailing 30 days
Data source: NOAA GHCN Houston Hobby or FRED Texas weather proxy series
No existing miner-pair position open
exit_conditions: Time stop: 20 trading days after entry

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: MARA, RIOT, CLSK, MSTR, IBIT, SPY (daily close)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: NOAA GHCN Houston/Austin daily Tmax (free CSV); fallback: any seasonal-summer indicator

backtest_approach: Daily PnL on the pair: ret_pair = ret(MSTR) - (1/3)*(ret(MARA) + ret(RIOT) + ret(CLSK)). 20-day hold per signal. Compare vs unconditional pair return over summer windows and vs IBIT (pure BTC) return. Sharpe, CAGR, hit-rate, max DD.

2024-06 to 2024-09 — second consecutive record-heat summer

name: EIA Crude Inv YoY Build Streak + WTI Near 52w High -> Short XOP
rule: Use FRED WCESTUS1 (weekly U.S. ending stocks of crude oil ex-SPR, Wednesday print). Compute YoY change = WCESTUS1(t) / WCESTUS1(t-52 weeks) - 1. STREAK condition: YoY > 0 for 4 consecutive weekly prints. WTI condition: CL=F front-month close within 5% of trailing 252 trading-day high. ENTER short XOP at next-day open when both conditions are true. HOLD 30 trading days (~6 weeks). EXIT early if (i) latest weekly WCESTUS1 YoY turns negative, (ii) CL=F breaks above prior 52w high by >+3%, or (iii) XOP declines >-8% from entry (profit target).
entry_conditions: Latest 4 weekly FRED WCESTUS1 prints all show YoY > 0
CL=F front-month close / CL=F trailing 252-day high >= 0.95
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: Latest WCESTUS1 weekly YoY print turns negative
XOP closes >8% below entry close (profit target)

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: XOP, XLE, CL=F, SPY (daily Close, auto_adjust=False)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: WCESTUS1 (Weekly U.S. Ending Stocks of Crude Oil, thousand barrels, weekly Wednesday)

backtest_approach: Daily PnL on short XOP. Counter-signal against long_energy default. Build weekly streak indicator from WCESTUS1; forward-fill to daily. Fire on rising-edge of (streak >= 4 AND CL=F within 5% of 252d high). Open 1-unit short XOP at next-day open. Daily PnL = -1 * XOP return while position open. Report Sharpe, hit-rate over 6-week windows, max DD, and excess return vs SPY (counter-signal validation against long_SPY default).

Counter-signal targets long_energy via XOP short — XOP is acceptable as a counter-signal primary target per the counter-signal rule. Cushing curve-slope condition from the original chain is approximated by 'CL=F near 52w high' (peak-price conditions encode contango/glut risk). FRED WCESTUS1 is total US ex-SPR commercial.

name: CMS IPPS Final Rule Net Market Basket Update >3% -> Long HCA

HOLD 40 trading days (~8 weeks). EXIT early on (i) HCA declines >-8% from entry, or (ii) HCA reports Q3 earnings (typically late Oct). The backtestable approximation uses calendar fixed-date entries (August 2 each year) with the empirical historical net basket update values hardcoded per year.
entry_conditions: Calendar date = early August (use fixed date August 2 each year as IPPS-release proxy)
Historical net market basket update for that fiscal year > 3.0% — see implementation_notes for hardcoded year-by-year values
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: Approximate Q3 earnings date (use October 25 each year as proxy)

Sample size of >3% firings is small (~2-3 in 2015-2025 window) so report n_events alongside Sharpe; this is more an event study than a high-frequency strategy. THC/UHS included for cross-validation. Q3 earnings proxy date (Oct 25) is approximate — actual HCA earnings dates vary; backtester can refine.

name: Google Trends ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude Share Inversion -> Short NVDA
rule: Using pytrends (free, unofficial Google Trends API), pull weekly search interest for 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'claude' in US, geo='US', 12-month windows stitched. Compute share-of-three: share_x(t) = volume_x(t) / (volume_chatgpt(t) + volume_gemini(t) + volume_claude(t)). Compute 4-week moving average of each share. Identify the dominant leader L over the trailing 26 weeks (the term with highest mean 4w MA share over that window). FIRE SHORT NVDA when, for 2 consecutive weeks, L's 4w MA share drops below at least one other term's 4w MA share (i.e., L loses #1 rank). HOLD 30 trading days (~6 weeks). EXIT early on NVDA next earnings date OR NVDA up >+15% from entry (stop).
entry_conditions: Compute 4w MA share for chatgpt/gemini/claude weekly Google Trends US
Identify trailing-26w leader L
For 2 consecutive weeks, L's 4w MA share has dropped below at least one other term
L was dominant (#1) for >=26 prior consecutive weeks before inversion
No open position from this signal
exit_conditions: NVDA next earnings date reached (approximate: use Feb 20, May 22, Aug 27, Nov 20 fiscal anchors)

HOLD 100 trading days (~5 months). EXIT early on (i) basket up >+15% (profit target), (ii) ELECPRIIDXM YoY drops below 0%, or (iii) basket down >-10% (stop).
entry_conditions: Calendar date = first trading day on or after July 28 of a year
FRED ELECPRIIDXM YoY >= +0.05
Equal-weight basket (VST+NRG+CEG) 90-day return < +0.20
No open position from this signal

data_sources_concrete.prices: yfinance: VST, NRG, CEG, TLN, SPY (daily Close, auto_adjust=False)
data_sources_concrete.fundamental: FRED: ELECPRIIDXM (Producer Price Index by Commodity: Utility Natural Gas — proxy for power market). If not available, substitute with PCU2211212211213 (electric power generation PPI) — backtester can use either.

backtest_approach: Event-study daily PnL on long equal-weight basket (1/3 VST + 1/3 NRG + 1/3 CEG). Annual seasonal anchor (July 28). On qualifying years, open basket at next-day open. Daily PnL = basket_return while open. Sample: VST inception Oct 2016, NRG 2003, CEG Feb 2022 — effective sample is constrained by CEG inception (Feb 2022); could use proxy substitute pre-2022 (VST+NRG only). Report n_events.
known_events: 2024-07 — PJM BRA $269.92/MW-day (massive YoY jump from $28.92)
implementation_notes: CEG (Constellation Energy) IPO'd Feb 2022 from Exelon spinoff — pre-2022 sample uses VST+NRG only. PJM BRA results are public discrete events but not in FRED. July 28 calendar anchor approximates the typical late-July BRA release date. ELECPRIIDXM (or PCU2211212211213) used as power-market-tightness regime filter.
